 The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.
   

  

 At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
   

  

 USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
   

  

**Brief Job Overview**
 Senior Talent Acquisition Partner is a key mission enabler at USP and we’re seeking an exceptional recruiter to join our team. Our new team member will lead their hiring managers through the full lifecycle of recruiting for a variety of professional, technical, scientific, and administrative positions. Primary responsibilities involve deep partnership and with business leaders and hiring managers to effectively source, recruit, evaluate, interview, and select top Acquisition/HR projects that will strengthen USP offerings and branding as an employer of choice.
   

  

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
 As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high\-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence\-based decision\-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
   

  

 Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high\-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results\-driven work environments.
   

  

**The Sr. TA Partner Has The Following Responsibilities**
* Conducts full lifecycle recruiting for assigned searches beginning with a strategy meeting with the hiring manager to discuss process and strategic sourcing approach
* Creates an effective sourcing strategy based on business needs and identify candidates through standard and creative methods
* Evaluates the resumes/profiles of prospective candidates and determines degree of skill match; recommends or declines appropriately and forwards qualified short\-listed candidate resumes to the hiring manager for review.
* Tracks candidate activity from initial resume submittal to hire in the applicant tracking system (ATS);
* Coordinates receiving and evaluating of interview feedback and advises hiring manager in the final selection process.
* Collaborates with the HRBP, Compensation \& Benefits and others as needed in establishing salaries.
* Checks references, verifies educational credentials, and coordinates background investigation of selected candidate; negotiates and makes verbal and written offers of employment.
* Works with colleagues to prepare weekly reports to monitor recruitment activity, tracks vacant positions, recruiting strategies/sources, and costs.
* Support in designing and executing employer branding initiatives to position the organization as an employer of choice, leveraging digital platforms and recruitment marketing tools.
* Analyze market trends and competitor practices to continuously refine talent attraction and branding strategies.


**Additional Roles And Responsibilities Include**
* Work on visually appealing and informative quarterly Dashboards and to be presented to the Leadership.
* Share Weekly Recruitment reports with the Leadership
* Work on Contract agreements and payments with various vendors as and when required
* Align and ensure the Headcount report is in alignment with Global HR and Finance teams.
* Ensure that all Job Portals and third\-party verification contracts are up to date and be the single point of contact for recruitment needs
* Ensure Talent acquisition is always Audit Compliant.
* Support on designing Recruitment policies and Manuals when required. Identifies processes and practices for continuous improvement and champions appropriate changes as needed.


**Who is USP Looking For?**
 The Successful Candidate Will Have a Demonstrated Understanding Of Our Mission, Commitment To Excellence Through Inclusive And Equitable Behaviors And Practices, Ability To Quickly Build Credibility With Stakeholders, Along With The Following Competencies And Experience
   

  

* Master's Degree/Post Graduate Diploma (Full\-Time) in Human Resource Management from a business school is preferred, with 10 years of professional recruiting experience to include leadership and strategic project experience.
* Demonstrated full\-lifecycle recruitment experience working in corporate or agency environments.
* Experience in cold calling, candidate development and directly sourcing candidates from a variety of media including standard sourcing tools (social networks, corporate websites, general job boards, professional associations, agencies, college postings and alumni organizations, open houses) to build candidate pipelines
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office is required, as is familiarity with applicant tracking systems (ATS)


**Additional Desired Preferences**
* Recruitment experience within Pharmaceuticals and/or health care life sciences, biotechnology industry.
* Experience in behavioral and/or competency\-based interviewing techniques
* Advanced ability to understand complex requirements and effectively communicate with hiring managers and candidates
* Strong partnership and relationship building skills with the ability to adjust to multiple changing, and often competing, priorities
* Ability to help build a pipeline of diverse candidate to help company achieve DEIB goals
* Excellent time management, communication, and project management skills
* Superior verbal and written communication skills
* Must be able to work independently as well as in a team environment
* Strong technology orientation and skills related to social networking, sourcing techniques.
* Experience working with HRIS systems, UltiPro/UKG is a plus


**Supervisory Responsibilities**
 Nil
   

  

**Benefits**
 USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company\-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well\-being is protected.
   

  

 Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.
   

  

**Job Category** 
 Human Resources
   

  

**Job Type** 
 Full\-Time

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
 At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.
   

  

 Our dedication to remote\-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
   

  

 We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!
   

  

**See yourself at Twilio**
 Join the team as Twilio’s next Senior Network Engineer.
   

  

**About The Job**
 This position is needed to help build, operate, and maintain the global corporate network infrastructure, VPN, ZTNA, and connectivity to our cloud\-based systems. As part of the Identity and Network Trust team, you will monitor network performance to proactively respond to incidents. You will need to possess the technical knowledge to troubleshoot and perform root cause analysis for escalated connectivity issues. You also will collaborate with the security team and other engineering teams to develop a secured global network infrastructure.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Build, operate and support the global Twilio IT network infrastructure.
* Keep track of network assets, including network hardware and software.
* Monitor the network performance, availability, utilization, throughput and latency, providing measurable metrics to the IT leadership team.
* Work closely with stakeholder teams to determine current and future network needs.
* Prioritize projects and work based on business priorities using the Scale Agile Framework (SAFe).
* Develop methods and tools to be used to test and implement new LAN/WAN systems.
* Analyze the current network structure and collaborate on how to make the network more efficient, scalable and sustainable.
* Formulate strategies to maintain and upgrade network systems efficiently.
* Respond to incidents, engage in network troubleshooting activities to determine root cause and resolve network issues.
* Create and maintain documentation for network design, IT network standards and process.
* Required:
* 7\+ years of experience with building campus and/or data center network infrastructure, AWS cloud services and networking
* 5\+ years of experience with Cisco LAN/WAN/Wifi and Palo Alto Networks firewalls
* 3\+ years experience with AWS cloud services and networking
* Advanced knowledge of IEEE 802 standards and core IETF networking protocols including 802\.11 suite, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing and switching protocols
* Hands on knowledge of network monitoring
* Knowledge of network security to implement security policy for compliance
* Proficient skill in WIndows, Mac, Linux client networking
* Experience in troubleshooting network problems at different OSI model layer
* University degree in computer science or equivalent experience
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills


**Desired**
* Cisco CCNA/CCNP Certification
* AWS certification
* Zscaler Zero Trust Systems experience and/or certifications
* Scripting language with API automation
* Experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform
* Knowledge of ITIL framework and its application in a network environment
* Project management skills


**Location**
 This role will be Remote and based in India (Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Maharashtra, Delhi)
   

  

**Travel**
 We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 15% travel is anticipated to help you connect in\-person in a meaningful way and perform job duties
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.
   

  

**Twilio thinks big. Do you?**
 We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.
   

  

 So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.
   

  

**Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.** 
 We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E\-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

title: System Studies Engineer
description:
**The Opportunity**
 In this role you will design authority for an engineering discipline with low to medium complexity. Complete assignments on small projects or portions of larger projects, cost\-effectively and in accordance with contract specifications, quality standards and safety requirements.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* You will understand and design of Electrical Power Systems and controls Preferably knowledge on IEC/IEEE standards.
* To successfully take on this position, you need to be thorough and structured with a high technical interest and strive for good solutions within the set time limits. You will be involved in projects, tenders, base work.
* To grow with each task, enabling yourself to develop and take more and more responsibility. HVDC is a complex product, there is always more to learn.
* You will model and study the stability of HVDC system through simulations in PSCAD/EMTDC, PSSE, Power factory and design the controllers.
* You will handle the interface with other interfacing departments. Ensuring you understand their needs, and they yours, and to work for a good corporation for best end results together.
* You will be responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Living Hitachi Energy core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.


**Your Background**
* You should have B.E. EEE (\> 5 years experience)/ Master of Engineering \- Power System (3 to 18 years experience)/ PhD \- Power System (1 to 5 years experience).
* Extensive knowledge of Power Systems studies and modelling of electrical network /HVDC/FACT.
* Preferably Understanding application of Power Electronics in HV/EHV system like HVDC and FACTS and proven skills in using computers as a calculation tool.
* Preferably experience of power system simulation tools such as PSSE, EMTDC /PSCAD, Power Factory and calculations in Matlab / Mathcad.
* Extensive knowledge of Power Systems equipment and their purpose, such as Power Transformers, Capacitors, Reactors, Instrument Transformer and measuring equipment, Circuit Breakers, Disconnector, Surge Arrester etc.
* Knowledge in selection, sizing and integration of above equipment based on customer functional specification, Knowledge of power system as per job description.
* Power Transmission Projects (EPC)Teamwork, Analytical skills.
* Strong interpersonal communication skill, fluency in English.


 Hitachi Energy is a global technology leader in electrification, powering a sustainable energy future through innovative power grid technologies with digital at the core. Over three billion people depend on our technologies to power their daily lives.
   

  

 With over a century in pioneering mission\-critical technologies like high\-voltage, transformers, automation, and power electronics, we are addressing the most urgent energy challenge of our time – balancing soaring electricity demand, while decarbonizing the power system.

description:

**Location:** 
 Mumbai, Andheri East (In\-Office) \|
 **Experience:** 
 0–3 years
 



  





 About Pepper
 



  





 Pepper is building an AI\-powered content and SEO growth platform, serving 2,500\+ global brands with 150,000\+ content creators. We're not just using AI—we're embedding it into everything we do. And we need builders to make that happen.
 



 The Role
 



  





**We need AI tinkerers who ship.** 




  





 You'll embed directly with teams across Pepper—Sales, Marketing, Content, Ops, Product—and do one thing:
 **find friction, build micro apps, automate the boring stuff.** 




 No 6\-month roadmaps. No endless PRDs. You see a problem Monday, you ship a working prototype by Wednesday.
 



  





 You'll report directly into the founder and functional leaders. Full access to data, systems, and context. Zero bureaucracy. Maximum velocity.

title: P&O - Business Partner
description:
Sandozis going through an exciting and transformative period as a global leader and pioneering provider of sustainable Biosimilar and Generic medicines.
  
  

Now as an independently listed company, Sandoz aims to increase its strategic focus, operate with greater agility, set clearer business objectives, enhance shareholder returns, and strengthen its culture for us, the Sandoz associates. This is an exciting time in our history, and by creating a new and ambitious path, it will provide a unique opportunity for us all, both professionally and personally.
  
  

Join us as a Founder of our ‘new’ Sandoz!
  
  

**Position Purpose:**  

To act as a trusted advisor offering in\-country policy expertise and knowledge to support and educate leaders, managers, and associates on all P topics on the moments that matter. People Partners support all divisional customer groups in country enabling the delivery of lifecycle events, the employee value proposition, talent acquisition, talent management, learning, performance management, employee relations, rewards, pay and reporting. In addition, People Partners implement P change initiatives at a country level acting as detailed designers and agents of change by working with Business Partners. The People Partner lead in small countries acts as a single point of contact within country to align on people partner related issues, above country topics and coordination of country team members. Typically manages P people partnering, where: \-Direct FTE supported by role (for Manager FTE supported by team); 400\+. \-Stakeholder Profile (Number of OPMs); 70\+
  
  

**Your Key Responsibilities:****Your responsibilities include, but not limited to:**  

* Partnering and mentor managers and associates on People related Processes and moments that matter. Drives P initiatives, supporting the overall P strategy \-Activate business ownership and accountability of diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives \-Advise on and handle diversity, equity and inclusion at all levels, e.g., gender representation, LGBTI, pay equity \-Champions culture and supports implementation of corporate initiatives (e.g. Evolve, hybrid working) \-Coaches and guides people managers on role evaluations in line with local governance.
* Communicate full spectrum of inclusion\& Psychological Safety \-Design new hire onboarding initiatives. Drive agreement and utilization of data and analytics to identify risk and trends, and to apply these business insights to advise decisions and actions.
* Drive D efforts and align with global or local initiatives / implementation. Drives quality, effectiveness, efficiency and continuous improvement for P People Partnering and related processes. Embraces customer feedback to understand the customer journey with moments that matter and drives continuous improvement. Implement improvements and modification as vital to meet both the business and customer needs. Ensure compliance with local equity / Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) regulations \-First point of escalation for all leaders and managers on their day\-to\-day P topics, providing expert advice, guidance and support.
* Lead the delivery of in\-country transformations, consult and negotiate with local works council / unions, provide advice and guidance for managers through the local process, oversee associate notice / handover meetings and overall restructuring lifecycle. Lead the execution of local implementation of large\-scale organizational and day\-to\-day organizational structure changes, in line with country regulations / policies.
* Leads alignment and harmonization of local regulations with P Board; monitors compliance, risk management and review P controls (as part of the NFCM framework) working with People Partner team. Handle internal movement offers and mobility. Promotes the contribution of ideas and solutions to the P network (Country Business Partners, Global Business Partners and Country P Boards).
* Provide credible P People Partnering to people leaders, manager and associates offering advice and guidance on the moments that matter.
* Provides mentor and counselling to Country P Business Partners on local policies and processes.
* Seeks to establish positive relationships with cross\-divisional P community members to understand needs and challenges and drive continuous improvement. Support and mentor leaders, manager and associates on all P topics including promoting self\-sufficiency in people processes. Support in country where there is no TAS presence.


**What you’ll bring to the role:****Essential Requirements:**  

* The ideal candidate must have a Master's degree in Human Resources from a reputed institute \[XLRI/TISS/ SCMHRD/XIMB/IIMs] and should possess proven experience of min 8\+ yrs.
* The candidate should possess a strong conceptual understanding of HR functional areas.
* Excellent communication, people management, project management, and communication skills are crucial for the candidate.
* The candidate should possess strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with a curiosity about data analysis, trend identification, and making strategic recommendations.
* The ideal candidate should have a history of successfully navigating ambiguous situations and constraints and be prepared to challenge conventional practices.
* Outstanding partner leadership skills required, with a proven track record relationships with senior leaders and various partners to facilitate organizational change.


Why Sandoz?
  
Sandoz is the global leader in Biosimilar and Generic medicines, a segment of the healthcare industry that delivers 80% of the world’s medicines at 30% of the cost, touching the lives of more than 1 billion people across 100\+ countries! While we are proud of our achievements, we have an ambition to do more so that everyone can achieve the basic human right of good health.
  
  

With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help even more people gain access to low\-cost, high\-quality medicines, sustainably.
  
  

Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills, experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful careers, where diversity of thought is welcomed and where personal growth is supported! 
  
 
  
Join us, help us make healthcare fairer and faster.
  
  

**Commitment to Diversity\& Inclusion:**  

We are committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.

Initial assignment is into creating a productive network of referral partners within the given branch area. Task is to enroll potential referral partners (Silver Envoys) and maintain strong relationships with them and generate enquiries (leads) for home interiors. The target for Silver Envoy enrolment \-Enroll 3 Silver Envoys (Potential referral partners) a day.

Support Client Manager

title: Barry-Wehmiller - Network Security Engineer ( 0-0 yrs )
description:
**Job Description**
 About Us:
   

  

 Barry\-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper\-converting industries. By blending people\-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose\-driven growth, Barry\-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Join Us. Build a Better World Through Business.
   

  

 At Barry\-Wehmiller Companies, we believe business can be a powerful force for good. Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, we are a global leader in manufacturing technology and services. Since our founding in 1885 as a maker of brewing machinery, we’ve grown through the acquisition of more than 80 companies, serving industries such as packaging, paper converting, sheeting, corrugating, engineering, and IT consulting. In 2016, we ranked No. 10 on the St. Louis Business Journal list of the city’s Top 150 Privately Held Companies.
   

  

 What truly sets us apart is our culture—rooted in Truly Human Leadership, a philosophy that prioritizes the well\-being and growth of every individual. We measure success by the way we touch lives, not just by financial results.
   

  

 In India, Barry\-Wehmiller operates as a hub of innovation and collaboration through our Global Competency Center (GCC) and other strategic functions. The GCC houses centers of excellence in engineering, content management, sourcing, software development, global IT operations, and shared financial services—providing critical support to Barry\-Wehmiller divisions worldwide.
   

  

**Our Culture Is Built On**
* Ownership – Drive features end\-to\-end, from design to deployment.
* Flexibility – A friendly, results\-oriented environment that respects your time.
* Empowerment – Your ideas matter, and your work creates visible impact.
* Learning and Growth – Tackle complex challenges alongside passionate peers, with continuous support for your development.


 Career Development and Global Exposure
   

  

 At Barry\-Wehmiller, your growth is our priority. You’ll have access to world\-class learning programs, leadership development opportunities, and mentorship from industry experts. Our global footprint means you’ll collaborate with teams across continents, gaining exposure to diverse markets, cutting\-edge technologies, and best practices from around the world. Whether you aspire to deepen your technical expertise or take on leadership roles, we provide the resources and support to help you thrive.
   

  

 If you’re ready to bring your best thinking to a high\-impact, future\-focused environment—where long\-term stability meets start\-up agility—and be part of a company that cares deeply about people, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

**Position Description**
 The Network Security Engineer is responsible for assisting with the planning, design, optimization, implementation, audit, and troubleshooting the Barry\-Wehmiller (BW) network from a security perspective to improve the protection and the efficiency of the organization. It is the responsibility of the NST to help plan and implement security measures to protect the system from cyber\-attacks, hacking attacks, intrusion, infiltration, exfiltration and natural disasters at the network level. This individual will help make our company’s information technology (IT) environment more secure by protecting system boundaries, keeping computer systems and network devices hardened against attacks, and securing company and personal data.
   

  

**Principal Duties And Responsibilities (Essential Functions)**
* Assist in planning, identifying, defining, engineering, and monitoring the security arrangements for the protection of the company’s network and services.
* Design secure remote access practices and implementation plans as well as make recommendations to secure BW’s footprint in BW and customer facilities; assist in designing and optimizing security in BW’s Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) initiatives
* Participate in projects to address gaps in BW’s on\-premises and cloud network environments.
* Assist in developing, documenting, and maintaining standard security policy settings for firewalls and other network security devices and appliances.
* Oversee daily operations of BW’s network security systems
* Assist the Infrastructure team with designing and documenting additional network segmentation and enhancing BW’s Information Technology / Operational Technology segregation.
* Manage daily operations of intrusion detection systems as well as ensure the security of firewalls, VPNs, web protocols and other networking equipment.
* Help investigate intrusion and hacking incidents, collect incident responses, and carry out forensic investigations as directed.
* Use industry\-standard analysis criteria to test the security level of the BW enterprise; test and check the BW enterprise for weaknesses in software and hardware by assisting with penetration tests, vulnerability assessments and then managing all findings to resolution.
* Assist with the implementation of regulatory systems in accordance with IT security.
* Help optimize malware and other threat detection systems and processes.
* Collaborate with the Infrastructure team regarding improving design and security capabilities, and determining network security standards and policies.
* Participate in implementation and integration projects such as conducting product research, overseeing proof of concept evaluations, coordinating with the Infrastructure team during acquisition integrations and implementations and overseeing the configuration and installation of security infrastructure devices.
* Configure and maintain systems that log and monitor security threats and alerts.


**Job Specifications**
* Knowledge of Cisco and Palo Alto firewalls and other next\-generation firewall technologies.
* Knowledge of Cisco ISE and its capabilities.
* Knowledge of Cisco Meraki.
* Knowledge of Netskope
* Knowledge of routing and switching capabilities.
* Strong logical ability, natural curiosity, problem solving ability, good oral and written communication skills, thorough, takes initiative, professional appearance/demeanor, dependable, flexible with schedule, loyal, organized, and courteous.
* Troubleshooting skills with networking and computer systems, can multitask, work in a fast\- paced environment while providing excellent user experience.
* Ability to work independently with general supervision; applies practical knowledge to problems.
* API programming experience strongly desired.


**Required Education And Experience**
* Intermediate level professional with working knowledge and experience in network security.
* Strong logical ability, natural curiosity, problem solving ability, good oral and written communication skills, thorough, takes initiative, professional appearance/demeanor, dependable, flexible with schedule, loyal, organized, and courteous.
* Four (4\) to five (5\) years of hands\-on experience working with IP networks, firewalls switch \| route environment
* Two (2\) years identifying threats and developing appropriate protection measures.


**Supervisory / Responsibility**
 This is a non\-supervisory position.
   

  

**Work Environment**
 This is an office position.
   

  

**Position Type**
 This is a regular, full\-time position with the understanding that a regular workweek will require extended days and hours as needed to meet business needs.
   

  

**Travel**
 Occasional domestic and/or global travel may be required for this position.
   

  

 We believe our culture differentiates us from other firms. To know more about us and our people\-centric culture, you may like to watch a 20 Minute video from Mr. Robert Chapman, CEO of Barry\-Wehmiller. Please click on the following link to watch the Truly Human Leadership video.
   

  

 Barry\-Wehmiller is a place where you can bring your best self to life through the work that you do — no matter the path you choose.
   

  

 Watch the video below to hear Barry\-Wehmiller President Kyle Chapman discuss how our vast career opportunities empower our team members to choose their own journeys, no matter who they want to be click here to watch
   

  

 At Barry\-Wehmiller we recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. We know that our differences often can bring about innovation, excellence and meaningful work—therefore, people from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply to our positions. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodations during the interview process.
   

  

**Company**

**Company Description**
 We’re Building A Better World.
   

  

 We’re more than just a successful capital equipment and engineering solutions firm. We’re an organization fiercely committed to improving the lives of our team members across the globe. By providing meaningful work in an environment of care and compassion, we send them home fulfilled by their time with us, rather than drained by it. We understand what every human being on the planet desires: to know that who they are and what they do matter. As a business, we have a unique opportunity to let them know that they do.
   

  

 Through our Truly Human Leadership culture and personal growth initiatives, we help them become their best selves. And when we bring out their best, they give their best. To their work, their team members and friends, our customers and suppliers, the people in the communities in which they work and live, and\-\-most important of all\-\-to their families. And before you know it, a better job has helped build a better world!

title: Fibre splicer
description:
**Position Title: Fiber Optic Splicer**

**Department:** Technical / Field Operations

**Reports To:** Field Supervisor / Project Manager

**Location:** As Assigned

1\. Job Summary

The Fiber Optic Splicer is responsible for installation, splicing, testing, maintenance, and repair of fiber optic cables to ensure uninterrupted broadband, IPTV, and leased line services. The role requires technical expertise, accuracy, safety compliance, and timely execution of assigned projects.

2\. Roles and ResponsibilitiesA. Fiber Splicing \& Termination

· Perform fusion and mechanical splicing of fiber optic cables.

· Prepare, strip, clean, and cleave fiber cables before splicing.

· Terminate fiber cables in ODF, patch panels, and distribution boxes.

· Ensure splice loss remains within acceptable standards.

B. Installation \& Deployment

· Install underground, aerial, and indoor fiber optic cables.

· Assist in cable laying, routing, and ducting activities.

· Install joint enclosures, splitter boxes, and fiber distribution units.

C. Testing \& Troubleshooting

· Conduct testing using OTDR, power meter, and light source.

· Identify and rectify fiber faults, breaks, and signal losses.

· Perform preventive maintenance and emergency restoration work.

· Maintain proper documentation of test results.

D. Maintenance \& Repair

· Respond promptly to service complaints and fiber cut issues.

· Repair damaged fiber cables and restore connectivity.

· Coordinate with technical teams during network outages.

E. Documentation \& Reporting

· Maintain daily work reports and job completion reports.

· Record splice loss readings and maintain fiber route details.

· Update inventory usage of fiber cables and materials.

F. Safety \& Compliance

· Follow company safety policies and use proper PPE.

· Ensure work is completed as per industry standards and company guidelines.

· Maintain tools and equipment in proper working condition.

3\. Required Skills \& Competencies

· Knowledge of fiber optic splicing and testing equipment.

· Ability to read fiber network diagrams and route maps.

· Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.

· Basic knowledge of broadband and IPTV network infrastructure.

· Good communication and teamwork skills.

· Willingness to work in field conditions and extended hours if required.

4\. Educational Qualification

· ITI / Diploma in Electronics, Telecommunications, or relevant field.

· Certification in Fiber Optic Technology (Preferred).

5\. Experience

· 1–3 years of experience in fiber optic splicing (Preferred).

· Freshers with technical training may also apply.

6\. Key Performance Indicators (KPI)

· Quality of splicing (minimum loss levels).

· Timely completion of assigned tasks.

· Quick fault resolution and restoration.

· Compliance with safety and reporting standards.

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

**Expertise You'll Bring:** 




  




* Strong hands\-on knowledge of reconciliation, configuration and development, including
* Data source and ingestion

title: Manager – HRBP & ER
description:
**About The Team**
 Our HR team operates as a strategic partner to the business, focused on cultivating a high\-performance culture where exceptional talent thrives. Our work is fundamentally guided by the DICE (Democratize Internet Commerce for Everyone) mission, which underpins our approach to all people strategies. Our core mandate centers on two critical pillars: driving world\-class Talent Density and continuously elevating Employee Experience. We achieve this by relentlessly attracting, developing, and retaining the highest caliber of professionals, ensuring that every individual contributes significantly to our success. Concurrently, we are committed to shaping an unparalleled employee experience—one defined by transparent communication, meaningful development, and a deeply engaging, inclusive culture. As stewards of the company's most valuable asset—its people—we design, implement, and champion people strategies that directly translate into sustained business growth and a position as one of India’s most sought\-after e\-commerce destinations.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a seasoned HR Business Partner to lead \& manage the 3P / Contract Workforce across multiple Teams and locations. This role will act as the primary HRBP for all third\-party employees, driving workforce governance, employee relations, compliance, \& productivity in close partnership with Operations. The incumbent will manage a team of 4 HRBPs and work closely with Staffing Partners, TA, HR Ops, Legal, and Business managers to ensure seamless lifecycle management, strong compliance discipline, and a high\-performance field workforce. This is a highly field\-intensive role requiring strong stakeholder management, ER expertise, data\-driven decision\-making, \& the ability to handle escalations with maturity \& speed.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Workforce Planning \& Hiring
* Partner with Business Manager and Biz finance teams on manpower planning \& workforce budgeting.
* Maintain visibility on headcount status, vacancies, redeployments, \& attrition trends across Teams.
* Coordinate with staffing vendors and TA to support hiring for 3P roles \& ensure timely fulfillment.
* Onboarding \& Documentation
* Oversee onboarding processes including documentation, BGV, contract issuance, \& HRMS updates.
* Ensure statutory compliance, minimum wages adherence, \& labour law norms during employee onboarding.
* Coordinate contract renewals and maintain complete lifecycle documentation.
* Attendance, Payroll \& Workforce Governance
* Validate payroll inputs, leave records, and attendance data in partnership with vendors \& HR Ops.
* Conduct regular audits to ensure compliance, documentation accuracy, \& audit readiness.
* Track productivity, attendance discipline, and overall workforce hygiene across Teams.
* Employee Experience \& Engagement
* Conduct regular employee connects, field visits, \& skip\-level meetings to proactively identify concerns.
* Standardize employee communication and drive awareness of policies and code of conduct.
* Implement structured grievance redressal mechanisms and ensure timely closure of employee concerns.
* Drive performance management processes for 3P employees in collaboration with Business teams
* Employee Relations \& Compliance
* Manage ER cases related to misconduct, fraud, absenteeism, performance issues,
* and policy violations.
* Conduct investigations, maintain documentation, and recommend appropriate
* disciplinary actions.
* Retention \& Attrition Management
* Conduct exit interviews, analyze attrition drivers, \& recommend targeted retention strategies.
* Partner with operations and vendors to address workforce stability \& redeployment needs.


**What You Will Need**
* Experience
* 6–10 years of progressive HR experience, with strong exposure to HRBP / Employee
* Relations roles.
* Proven experience managing large blue\-collar / contract / 3P workforce across multiple
* locations.
* Hands\-on experience handling ER cases including misconduct, disciplinary actions, fraud
* investigations, and grievance management.
* Strong exposure to labour law compliance, statutory audits, minimum wages, and
* contractor governance.
* Experience partnering closely with Operations / Business leaders in a high\-volume,
* field\-intensive environment.
* Prior experience managing or leading a small HR team is preferred.
* Experience working with staffing vendors and coordinating lifecycle processes including
* hiring, onboarding, payroll inputs, BGV, and exits.
* Education
* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources or equivalent post\-graduate qualification in HR.
* Graduation in any discipline from a recognized university.
* Additional certification in Labour Laws, POSH, or Industrial Relations will be an added
* advantage.
* Competencies
* Strong Employee Relations and conflict resolution capability.
* High ownership mindset with ability to handle escalations independently.
* Strong understanding of labour laws and statutory compliance frameworks.
* Stakeholder management skills with ability to influence operations leaders.
* Data\-driven decision making; ability to track and interpret workforce metrics.
* Excellent investigation, documentation, and case management skills.
* Strong communication and field connect capability with blue\-collar workforce.
* Ability to work in ambiguous, fast\-paced, and high\-pressure environments.
* Willingness to travel extensively and manage multi\-location operations.
* Team leadership capability with ability to coach and develop direct reports.

title: Resource Manager
description:

**So, what’s the role all about?**
 The Resource Manager Maintains and enhances the organization's human resources by planning, implementing, and evaluating employee relations and human resources policies, programs, and practices.

* Should be flexible to work in America’s 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM IST shift.

title: SmartQ - Senior Manager - Compensation & Benefits ( 0-0 yrs )
description:
**Job Description**
 About SmartQ
   

  

 SmartQ is redefining how the world experiences food. As a next\-generation food\-tech innovator, we solve real operational challenges through empathy\-led insights and powerful technology. Our mission is clear: to elevate everyday dining into a seamless and meaningful experience.
   

  

 In the last decade, we’ve transformed cafeteria and food operations across industries with scalable, cutting\-edge solutions. Operating in 14 countries and backed by Compass Group\- a $60B global foodservice leader SmartQ continues to push the boundaries of what modern food\-tech can achieve.
   

  

 Since our inception in 2015, we’ve become a trusted partner for corporates, hospitals, universities, and food courts worldwide. With a bold vision to become the world’s largest B2B food\-tech company, we connect people through exceptional food experiences powered by advanced technology. Today, we proudly serve 400\+ global clients, including leaders like Google, HSBC, Amazon, and Wells Fargo.
   

  

 At the heart of SmartQ is a culture shaped by four core pillars
   

  

 Great People \| Great Food \| Great Experience \| Greater Good
   

  

 These values inspire collaboration, innovation, humility, and a relentless pursuit of excellence.
   

  

 To dive deeper into what drives us, explore our cultural pillars on the SmartQ LinkedIn ‘Life’ page. It offers an authentic glimpse into the journey you could be part of: https://www.linkedin.com/company/smartq\-bottlelabs/life/cdc290f8\-ff81\-4e7f\-9c96\-37d842f936c4/?viewA…
   

  

 Are you passionate about designing competitive, data\-driven compensation programs that attract, retain, and motivate top talent? If so, we’d love to hear from you!
   

  

 As a Senior Manager – Compensation \& Benefits, you will play a strategic role in developing and managing comprehensive total rewards programs that align with our business objectives and organizational values. Partnering closely with HR leadership and cross\-functional stakeholders, you’ll drive the design, implementation, and optimization of compensation structures, incentive plans, and benefits initiatives that support growth and performance across the organization.
   

  

 This is an exciting opportunity for a forward\-thinking professional who thrives on analytics, compliance, and strategic planning within a dynamic and evolving environment. Ready to make a meaningful impact and elevate our people strategy? Join us and help shape the future of our workforce.
   

  

 What you will be doing
   

  

* Design, review, and manage compensation packages and bonus programs aligned with the organization’s strategic objectives.
* Ensure all salaries and benefits comply with human rights, pay equity legislation, and updates under the New Labor Code.
* Design and manage incentive schemes and policies.
* Monitor market trends and implement innovative practices to enhance employee engagement and motivation.
* Conduct compensation and benefits benchmarking exercises to maintain competitiveness.
* Support and manage periodic audits, preparing comprehensive reports for management.
* Oversee end\-to\-end payroll processing, taxation, and statutory compliance.
* Ensure full compliance with labor regulations, including the Contract Labor (Regulation \& Abolition) Act (CLRA).
* Develop, implement, and maintain HR policies, procedures, and regulatory frameworks.
* Supervise all compliance\-related business operations, including policies, investments, and procedures.
* Manage merit\-based salary increase processes within established timelines.
* Oversee HR dashboards and reporting to provide actionable insights for leadership.
* Manage payroll processing for programs for NATS and oversee the HRIS system (Keka) to ensure accurate and efficient workforce management.


 What you need to bring
   

  

* Experience as a Compensation \& Benefits and Payroll Manager with expertise in HR analytics, compliance, and MIS.
* Hands\-on experience with HRIS and payroll systems.
* Skilled in designing compensation packages, incentive programs, and job evaluation systems.
* Strong knowledge of CLRA, labor laws, and statutory compliance.
* MBA or equivalent in Human Resources, Finance, or related field.


 Message from CEO
   

  

 We've come to realize that we're not merely in the B2B Food service industry; we're in the business of 'Capturing Hearts.' We find ourselves in a unique position to turn ordinary, mundane corporate cafeterias into places of pure delight, where individuals can freely express themselves, find inspiration, and share happiness. Such a profound transformation opportunity is a rare gift, where the purpose of our enterprise transcends the ordinary. If this vision resonates with you, we invite you to join us in our mission to spread joy and happiness in a world weighed down by stress and pressure. Together, let's play our part in making this world a more beautiful place
   

  

**Company Description**
 Backed by the world’s largest food contract company, Compass Group, SmartQ offers the finest food experiences powered by seamless technology in the B2B segment, ultimately flowing to B2C. Striving beyond quality food, SmartQ believes in the principle of serving clients and the ultimate consumers wholeheartedly. This principle is then brought to life by aggregating a wide variety of food partners, from local heroes to glorious gourmets, to offer the widest choices for the end users. In addition to the delicacy, an end\-to\-end digital cafeteria suite is installed at corporate companies, tech parks, and universities that displays a two\-pronged advantage\-a seamless ordering process and an efficient order management system at the food court. SmartQ crosses boundaries to leisure segment by partnering with mega events, like Lollapalooza, Sunburn, MotoGP Bharat, to provide a complete food and beverages experience.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**About Flow Interio** 
 :
 



 Flow Interio is a leading interior designing company, committed to transforming spaces with innovative, functional, and aesthetic designs. We focus on creating bespoke interior experiences for residential, commercial, and corporate spaces. Join our dynamic team to contribute to the growth and success of our brand while nurturing talent and fostering a positive workplace culture.
 



  





**Position Overview** 
 :
 



 We are looking for a motivated and experienced Human Resources Manager to oversee all aspects of HR at Flow Interio. The HR Manager will be responsible for talent acquisition, employee development, performance management, and maintaining a positive work environment. The ideal candidate will have strong interpersonal skills, experience in managing HR processes, and a deep understanding of the creative and design industry.We are seeking a highly skilled HR Manager. Female candidates are preferred for this role, given organizational requirements.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 
 :
 


1. **Recruitment \& Onboarding** 
 :


* Manage the recruitment process, from posting job openings to conducting interviews and finalizing hires.
* Develop and maintain a robust talent pool for different roles within the company.
* Oversee the onboarding process to ensure smooth integration of new employees into the company culture.



**2\.Employee Relations** 
 :
 


* Foster a positive work environment by handling employee grievances, conflicts, and concerns.
* Organize team\-building activities and employee engagement initiatives to enhance morale and collaboration.
* Act as a liaison between management and employees to promote clear communication and resolve issues.



**3\.Performance Management** 
 :
 


* Implement and manage performance appraisal systems to evaluate and enhance employee performance.
* Provide support and guidance to managers in handling employee performance issues.
* Ensure that employee goals align with company objectives and facilitate growth opportunities.



**4\.Training \& Development** 
 :
 


* Identify training and development needs and recommend programs to enhance employees’ skills and knowledge.
* Coordinate internal and external training workshops, seminars, and certifications.
* Promote continuous learning and career development for employees.



**5\.Compensation \& Benefits** 
 :
 


* Oversee the payroll process to ensure timely and accurate payments.
* Manage employee benefits programs and ensure compliance with legal requirements.
* Conduct market research to ensure competitive salary and benefit packages.



**6\.Compliance \& Legal** 
 :
 


* Ensure the company’s compliance with labor laws, industry regulations, and health and safety guidelines.
* Maintain employee records in accordance with company policies and legal requirements.
* Advise management on HR best practices and legal matters related to employee relations.



**7\.HR Strategy \& Reporting** 
 :
 


* Contribute to the development and execution of HR strategies that support company growth and culture.
* Provide regular HR reports and insights to senior management on employee satisfaction, retention, and overall HR performance.
* Monitor industry trends and apply best practices to improve HR functions.



  





**Qualifications \& Skills** 
 :
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field (Master’s preferred).
* Minimum of 3 years of experience in HR management, with at least 1 year in a managerial role, preferably within the interior design, architecture, or creative industry.
* In\-depth knowledge of HR processes, labor laws, and employee relations.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Proficient in MS Office and HR software (HRMS, Payroll systems).
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information.



  





  





**Key Attributes** 
 :
 


* Strong leadership skills with the ability to influence and engage employees.
* Problem\-solving and conflict resolution skills.
* Passion for fostering a positive and inclusive workplace culture.
* Creative mindset with a focus on employee engagement and retention.

The Global Process Leader (GPL) Human Resources is a critical strategic enabler of the GBS organization, including the GBS 2\.0 transformation, responsible for end\-to\-end global ownership, optimization, and digitization of enterprise business processes across Human Resources.
 



  





 The GPL role exists to de‑risk and maximize the value of Olympus’ ERP/HRMS, AI, and Global Target Operating Model (GTOM) investments by ensuring processes are globally harmonized, digitally enabled, performance‑driven, and scalable across captive, outsourced, and AI‑based delivery models.
 



  





 Acting with dual accountability, the GPL:
 


* Leads process execution and excellence for Human Resources within GBS, leading a globally distributed organization of internal and outsourced personnel, and
* Drives enterprise‑wide process transformation across human resources, ERP/HRMS programs, AI initiatives, and data platforms.



  





 The GPL partners with Human Resources Global Process Owners (GPOs), GBS Capability and AI teams, and GBS delivery operations to deliver transformative and optimized business process execution.
 



  




* Global Process Ownership \& Harmonization
* In partnership with the business process owners within human resources, own the end‑to‑end global design, standards, and performance of assigned Level‑1 and Level‑2 business processes.
* Drive global process harmonization, reducing regional variants and eliminating fragmentation across captive, outsourced, and functional teams.
* Define clear process governance, controls, and decision rights aligned to enterprise risk, compliance, and quality standards.

* Partner, coach, and challenge ERP/HRMS and functional teams to maximize transformation value and avoid suboptimal “lift‑and‑shift” outcomes.

* Digital‑First \& AI Enablement Identify, prioritize, and implement AI, automation, and agentic solutions across owned processes in line with the GBS 2\.0 roadmap.
* Build and scale process excellence and AI capabilities as a service, working closely with the GBS Innovation Hub.

 The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.
   

  

 At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. * Good verbal and written communication skills.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**ALL WAVE AV SYSTEMS PVT. LTD.** 





 In\-House Talent Acquisition Specialist
 





 Location: Navi Mumbai
 





 Reports to: HR Consultant Head
 





 Experience: 3\+ Years \| Full\-time
 




  





**About All Wave AV Systems** 




  






 All Wave AV Systems Pvt. Ltd. is India's foremost Audio Visual and Unified Communications integrator, built over 25\+ years of engineering excellence. Headquartered at Fort, Mumbai, with branches in Pune, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, NCR and Kolkata, we serve enterprises, government and institutions across the country.
 




  






 With 5,600\+ successful AV installations, 800\+ corporate clients and one of the highest AMC conversion rates in the industry, Allwave designs, supplies, installs and maintains AV environments built for precision and reliability. We work across boardrooms, auditoriums, command centres, hybrid collaboration spaces, digital signage networks and smart workplaces — programming and integrating platforms from Crestron, AMX, Extron and other global OEMs under AVIXA and ISO 9000 aligned QA/QC processes.
 




  






 Founded by Mr. Kuldip Kamat — who returned from the US with a Master's in Electrical Systems Engineering — Allwave was built on the discipline of global standards and the energy of homegrown entrepreneurship. Our culture is can\-do, process\-driven and uncompromising on ethics. We are future\-driven, productivity\-focused, transparent and agile.
 




  





**Our Global Standing — PSNI Global Alliance** 




  






 All Wave AV Systems is a proud Certified Solution Provider (CSP) of the PSNI Global Alliance — the oldest and largest network of AV and UC integrators in the world, with 250\+ offices across 60\+ countries and a combined annual network turnover exceeding USD 5\.6 billion. Founded in 1986 in Chicago, PSNI membership is by invitation only, requiring the highest industry certifications, peer audits and demonstrated delivery standards.
 




  






 For Allwave, PSNI membership means operating at a global level of expectation. When multinationals need standardised AV infrastructure across India, or international integrators need a trusted local partner in Mumbai, they call a PSNI CSP. For our people, it means working with world\-class processes, international benchmarks and the collective knowledge of the finest AV minds on the planet.
 




  





**Our Culture** 




  






 We move fast, take ownership and hold ourselves to a high standard — not because someone is watching, but because we care. We want people who bring energy, take initiative and treat challenges as problems worth solving. Drama, politics and the clerical mindset have no place here. The AV and UC industry evolves rapidly and we expect our people to evolve with it — curious, direct and focused on outcomes. Your contribution is visible here, your ideas are heard, and your growth is tied directly to the company's growth.
 




  





**The Role** 




  






 We are looking for an energetic, sharp and self\-driven recruiter to join Allwave full\-time and build the talent pipeline that powers our next phase of growth. This is not a transactional role. You will be embedded with the business, working with hiring managers and leadership to attract, assess and onboard the best talent across AV, UC, IT, ELV and adjacent fields. Based at Navi Mumbai, with less than 10% travel to other Mumbai offices.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Talent Acquisition \& Sourcing** 




 •    
 
 Own end\-to\-end recruitment — from job briefing and sourcing through to offer rollout and onboarding handover.
 




 •    
 
 Build active pipelines across AV, IT, ELV and Unified Communications verticals through proactive, daily sourcing.
 




 •    
 
 Execute targeted headhunting strategies — identifying and approaching talent at competitor organisations.
 




 •    
 
 Drive campus recruitment, building relationships with engineering colleges and polytechnics for fresher and lateral pipelines.
 




 •    
 
 Test new sourcing methods continuously, track what works and iterate — posting\-and\-waiting is not acceptable here.
 




  





**Platform Expertise \& Daily Outreach Volume** 




  






 This role demands a high\-volume, multi\-platform operator. A minimum of 80 meaningful candidate outreaches per day is expected across all active channels combined — with proper tracking and timely follow\-up on every conversation.
 




  





 •    
 **LinkedIn Recruiter —** 

 Expert\-level proficiency required. Boolean search strings, InMail sequencing and response rate optimisation, Recruiter project organisation, candidate tagging, Spotlight filters, open\-to\-work indicators, alumni search and pipeline management. Talent Insights for market mapping is a strong advantage. Low InMail response rates must be addressed by improving messaging, not reducing volume.
 




 •    
 **Naukri Resdex —** 

 Advanced database search by keyword, function, industry, current employer and salary range. Skilled use of mass mailing tools, job posting optimisation, candidate response management and database tagging. Ability to read profile freshness signals and prioritise active versus passive candidates.
 




 •    
 **Apna —** 

 Proficiency for blue\-collar, field technician, site supervisor and support staff roles. Active use of in\-app screening, interview scheduling and employer dashboard.
 




 •    
 **Shine / Hirist / IIMJobs / Instahyre —** 

 Working knowledge for specialist and mid\-to\-senior hiring. Concurrent multi\-platform management without dropping follow\-ups.
 




 •    
 **WhatsApp \& Referral Networks —** 

 Active participation in recruiter communities and industry groups. Building and maintaining a personal referral network across the AV, IT and ELV ecosystem.
 




  





**⚡ Daily Outreach Expectation** 





 80\+ meaningful outreaches per day across LinkedIn, Naukri, Apna and other channels. This is a structured habit — targeted searches, personalised messages, timely follow\-ups and proactive pipeline building.
 





 You will maintain a daily outreach log and share weekly pipeline summaries with the HR Consultant Head.
 




  





**Assessment \& Candidate Experience** 




 •    
 
 Conduct structured screening interviews and coordinate technical assessments with functional heads.
 




 •    
 
 Ensure zero candidate ghosting — every screened applicant receives a response regardless of outcome.
 




 •    
 
 Represent Allwave credibly and compellingly; be a genuine ambassador for the brand.
 




  





**Salary Benchmarking \& Market Intelligence** 




 •    
 
 Run regular benchmarking using Naukri salary data, LinkedIn compensation tools and industry contacts.
 




 •    
 
 Advise hiring managers on realistic compensation before roles go live to prevent late\-stage offer drops.
 




 •    
 
 Share periodic market intelligence on candidate availability, competitor hiring activity and AV/IT/ELV pay trends.
 




  





**Reporting \& Administration** 




 •    
 
 Maintain live recruitment trackers — outreach volumes, response rates, pipeline stages, offer conversion and time\-to\-fill.
 




 •    
 
 Prepare weekly and monthly hiring dashboards for the HR Consultant Head and leadership.
 




 •    
 
 Manage job postings, tracker hygiene and sourcing platform vendor relationships.
 




 •    
 
 Write original, compelling job descriptions independently. All documentation — JD approvals, offer letters, interview feedback — must be organised and audit\-ready.
 




  





**What We Are Looking For** 




  





**Experience \& Skills** 




 •    
 
 3\+ years of recruitment experience in\-house or at a search firm with corporate technical placements.
 




 •    
 
 Proven track record of 80\+ daily outreaches — be ready to walk us through how you structure and sustain this volume.
 




 •    
 
 Expert LinkedIn Recruiter: Boolean search, InMail optimisation, pipeline management, Talent Insights.
 




 •    
 
 Advanced Naukri Resdex: mass mailing, database search, candidate shortlisting and tracking.
 




 •    
 
 Working knowledge of Apna, Shine, Hirist, IIMJobs or Instahyre.
 




 •    
 
 Hiring experience across IT, AV, ELV or technical engineering functions — campus and lateral.
 




 •    
 
 Comfortable with salary benchmarking and translating market data into practical hiring guidance.
 




 •    
 
 Strong written communication — able to draft compelling JDs, outreach messages and hiring reports independently.
 




 •    
 
 Proficient in Excel or Google Sheets for tracker maintenance and dashboard reporting.
 




  





**Mindset \& Character** 




 •    
 
 High energy — the kind that lifts the room, not exhausts it.
 




 •    
 
 Relentlessly proactive — pipelines are built before requisitions become urgent.
 




 •    
 
 Adaptable — shifting priorities and new role profiles do not throw you off.
 




 •    
 
 Direct and practical — you get to the point and move forward without unnecessary escalation.
 




 •    
 
 Low drama — outcomes matter more than optics; relationships are built on trust, not politics.
 




 •    
 
 Curious about technology — you invest time understanding what you are hiring for, not just the job title.
 




 •    
 
 Innovative — you are always looking for a smarter way to find and attract the right person.
 




  





**Why Join Allwave** 




  






 Allwave offers a growing, purpose\-driven company with genuine global credentials, accessible leadership and real autonomy. You will build the talent function, shape the employer brand and create the pipelines that define Allwave's next chapter — not shuffle requisitions from a queue. High volume where it needs to be. High quality, always.
 




  






 All Wave AV Systems Pvt. Ltd. \| Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra \| www.allwaveav.com \| PSNI Global Alliance Certified Solution Provider

title: Network Engineer
description:
**About Us**
 At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
   

  

 At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI\-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
   

  

**Responsibilities** 
 :
   

  

 We are looking for a Network Engineer to join our team (5\+yrs). Cloudflare is building one of the largest, most resilient networks that spans over 335 cities spread across all regions and we plan to continue our expansion at a rapid pace. You will have the opportunity to (literally) build a faster, safer Internet for our millions of users and the billions of web surfers that visit their sites each month.
   

  

 This position will be responsible for :
   

  

* Technical operation and engineering of the Cloudflare network, including the provisioning and management of the network hardware and software,
* Day to day network operations and monitoring, working closely with internal teams such as System Reliability Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering and Customer Support teams,
* Creating and maintaining documentation, SOP’s, knowledge base,
* Interacting with our network peers to assist with their inquiries, and subsequently provide meaningful data on performance degradation.


**Requirements**

* Capable of learning new technologies / systems / features under guidance of mentors,
* Proficient in multiple network vendor operating systems , Associate level network certification(s) (JNCIA , CCNA , etc) or higher,

**What Makes Cloudflare Special?**

**Athenian Project** 
 : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.
   

  

**1\.1\.1\.1** 
 : We released 1\.1\.1\.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy\-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use \- it is the first consumer\-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal \- we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.
   

  

 Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!
   

  

 This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.
   

  

 Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. title: Network Engineer
description:
**POSITION DESCRIPTION:**




  





 The Network Engineer is a proactive, hands\-on technical professional responsible for ensuring the reliability, performance, and security of Holiday Inn Club Vacations’ on\-premises, cloud, and campus\-wide network infrastructure. This role owns network monitoring and alerting, oversees Cisco Meraki and voice administration (CUCM), maintains UPS power systems, and provides Tier‑4 support for wired and wireless connectivity. The ideal candidate lives and breathes network operations, embraces continuous improvement, and delivers top‑tier customer service.
 



  





  





**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND TASKS:**




  




* Own network monitoring and observability: design dashboards, tune alerts, and generate trend reports in Datadog (or SolarWinds) so the network team is aware of issues before users are impacted.
* Manage day‑to‑day network operations: triage incidents, fulfill service requests, and execute approved changes via the internal ITSM platform.
* Configure and support Cisco Meraki infrastructure (MX firewalls, switches, wireless APs), including deployments, upgrades, and hardware replacements.
* Administer and troubleshoot Palo Alto next\-generation firewalls and Palo Alto Prisma Access for secure remote connectivity.
* Collaborate with security teams to enforce network security policies, firewall rules, and compliance standards.
* Participate in network architecture planning and suggest optimizations or upgrades.
* Administer Cisco Call Manager (CUCM) voice platform — voice administration only (endpoint configuration, firmware updates, issue troubleshooting).
* Maintain and monitor APC UPS and PDU systems: track lifecycle, patch firmware, replace batteries, and plan proactive replacements to prevent outages.
* Plan and validate power requirements (120/240 V single/three‑phase) and specify correct NEMA connectors and power cords (e.g., C13/C14\).
* Perform Wi‑Fi surveys and basic RF troubleshooting using Ekahau; optimize Meraki wireless deployments for coverage and performance.
* Fabricate and test copper network cables (Cat5e/Cat6\) to CompTIA Network\+ standards.
* Execute scheduled maintenance windows (firmware upgrades, backups) following change‑management procedures.
* Provide after‑hours/on‑call support in a rotating schedule for critical outages and urgent issues.
* Maintain clean and organized IDF/MDF environments: cable management, dust removal, disposal of old equipment, and general housekeeping.
* Deliver excellent customer service: communicate clearly, present professionally, and foster a respectful support experience.
* Collaborate with cloud and security teams to support network services in Azure and perform basic traffic diagnostics (port/protocol checks, packet captures).
* Document and label all network equipment, cables, and racks according to company standards.
* Maintain thorough ticket documentation: detailed troubleshooting notes, resolution steps, and linked knowledge articles.
* Create and update basic network diagrams (Visio, Lucidchart) for topology visibility and onboarding.
* Meet defined SLAs for ticket acknowledgment and resolution; actively monitor queue and escalate as necessary.



  





  





**EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE**




  




* 3\+ years of experience in a Network Engineer role, with 5\+ years in a network support role.
* Hands‑on expertise with
 **Cisco Meraki firewalls, switches, Palo Alto Firewall, Prisma, and wireless solutions.**
* Experience administering Cisco Call Manager (CUCM) or similar VoIP platforms.
* CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS
* CompTIA Network\+ and Security\+
* Cisco CCNA, CCNP Enterprise, or Meraki CMNA
* Palo Alto Networks or similar firewall certification
* **Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ‑900\)**
* Note: Certifications are not required on hire, but are expected to be obtained and maintained. The company covers training and successful exam costs; exam retakes after failed attempts are not reimbursed.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS**




  




* Strong proficiency with Datadog, SolarWinds, or comparable network monitoring tools.
* Working knowledge of APC UPS systems, power distribution, and NEMA standards.
* Ability to specify correct cabling/connectors for power and network gear.
* Proficient in Wi‑Fi survey tools (Ekahau) and troubleshooting.
* Basic scripting or automation skills (Python, PowerShell) are a plus.
* Excellent communication and customer service skills.
* Working knowledge of single‑mode and multimode fiber types, optics (SFP/SFP\+), and best practices for campus inter‑switch links.
* Ability to produce clear network diagrams and documentation using diagramming tools (Visio, Lucidchart, etc.).
* In\-depth knowledge of TCP/IP, BGP, VLANs, VPNs, NAT, QoS, and wireless technologies.
* Understanding of cloud networking concepts (e.g., AWS, Azure, or GCP integrations) is a plus.
* Strong organizational and troubleshooting skills
