**Job Summary**
 We are looking for an hands\-on Senior Network Engineer with minimum 5 years’ experience. An ideal candidate preferably should have worked as an Network Engineer for an IT infrastructure service provider / IT solutions integration company in past.
   

  

 The candidate is expected to understand customer requirements /Pain areas over call, email or meeting , come up with an innovative Network/Network Security solution.s\& even conduct as onsite /remote POC(Proof of Concept) \& pitch to different customers as required.
   

  

 Finally, candidate should be able to implement the accepted plan, training client team/s appropriately, coordinate with client, build or polish documentation and hand over the setup after acceptance.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is expected to train internal team members also , grow internal knowledge base (KB) and lead the Network Practice for the company going forward.
   

  

 In simplest terms imagine going to one of 600\+ customers when a customer is facing a problem that they are not able to resolve internally. Understand the problem, pitch a solution, implement it and go after next problem. You can assume different problems, different devices, different architectures at each client and thus, unparalleled learning and growth. All this would be with team members who share the same passion for learning and issue resolution.
   

  

**Responsibilities And Duties**
**Core Tasks:**
* Provide ongoing support on all areas of data center networking, which involves configuring routers, switches, load balances , Firewalls Etc..
* Configuring and managing security appliances and next generation firewalls from various vendors such as check point, Cisco ASA, Juniper, Sophos\- Cyberroam and FortiGate Etc.
* Should be good at handling technologies like NMS, WAF, DDOS, VPN and IPS
* Should have an experience in configuring WiFi access points, controllers and WiFi security solutions
* Assist in design / development of network products and solutions
* Assist in network\-based projects and development
* Preparing network diagrams / documentation based on the project needs
* Dealing with all types of network\-related incidents to ensure that Service Level Agreements with customers are adhered to.
* Build and maintain working relationships with key interconnect partners \& Customers
* Provide 24×7 support on request from the customer as an exception. This support might often require travel to customers location/s. (Note\- Ad\-hoc calls are minimal, typically at most one call a month. Most other calls are planned down\-time / maintenance calls).
* Strong working knowledge in vulnerability assessment, network audits and throughput testing is preferred.


**Education**
**Required Experience, Skills and Qualifications**
 (UG – Any Graduate – Any Specialization) OR (PG\- Any Postgraduate, Post Graduation Not Required) AND (Doctorate\- Any Doctorate – Any Specialization, Doctorate Not Required)
   

  

**Additional Skills \& Qualifications**
* Effective communicator – verbal, written and presentation skills
* Should have good communication skills \& excellent customer interfacing skills
* Should be good at time management \& should have the ability \& desire to learn new skills.
* Should have good analytical/problem solving skills
* Exposure on ITIL processes is preferred


**Competencies**
* Understands underlying issues and develops and evaluates solutions
* Excellent general knowledge of TCP/IP
* OEM certification such as CCNA, CCNP, Juniper etc. are preferred
* Excellent knowledge on switching technologies and concepts such as STP, VRRP, VTP, Stacking, LLDP, L2 Security \& 2/3 Tier architecture
* Routing Protocols (preferred) such as IS\-IS/ BGP4 (including some routing policy knowledge)/ OSPF/ EIGRP/ RIP/ Security/Redundancy Features
* Excellent general knowledge of TCP/IP
* Operational experience of load\-balancers technologies, particularly F5 BigIP and Cisco ACE.


**Desirable Requirements**
* General background in networking/ISP – knowledge of ISP\-type services, DNS, DHCP,WINS
* Some Unix experience, especially with the Vi editor
* Some operational experience of IP VPN technologies such as IP Sec, MPLS and GRE
* Required education: Bachelor’s Degree
* Required experience (Either one): Switching \& Routing: 5 years or Firewall: 5 years


**Note:** 
 Fairly experienced candidates with 6\+ years’ experience, who do free\-lancing, consulting, etc. can also apply.

title: Network Engineer
description:
**About Xerox Holdings Corporation**
 At Xerox,
 **we make work, work!** 
 For more than 100 years, Xerox has continually redefined the workplace experience. From the office to industrial environments, our differentiated business and technology offerings and financial services are essential workplace technology solutions that drive success for our clients and within our culture. Learn more at www.xerox.com and explore our commitment to diversity, inclusion and belonging.
   

  

 Job Title
   

  

 Network Engineer
   

  

 Job Description:
   

  

 Our technology is outstanding, but it’s the talented, diverse, and driven people behind our company who make it all happen. Our employees have the determination to go further, the adaptability to adjust to an ever\-changing global market, the heart to stay passionate and personally invested, and the mind to know when to step back and put it all in perspective.
   

  

 Lexmark (A Subsidiary of Xerox Corporation) is in search of a seasoned network operations engineer with a passion for operating, executing, and enhancing standard processes for maintaining an enterprise network. The selected candidate will collaborate with multiple teams to ensure the implementation of IT operations, security, and network policies. The role involves working with architecture and business teams to ensure the availability of the enterprise network. The engineer will also be responsible for monitoring tool efficiency, setting guidelines, and eliminating barriers to achieve desired outcomes. Additionally, they will liaise with other IT operation teams to resolve any network\-related issues. The ideal candidate must possess robust communication skills and the ability to manage competing priorities effectively.
   

  

 WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING:
   

  

 Remote Administration and troubleshooting of switches, routers, firewalls, and cloud networks.
   

  

 Configuration and management of multiple network security systems to include next gen firewalls, unified threat management services, and Secure Access Service Edge (SASE).
   

  

 Deployment of public cloud network services including virtual networks, load balancers, web application firewalls, and virtual gateways.
   

  

 Execution of standard network delivery processes such as VLAN creation, route advertisements, firewall policy configurations, DNS record changes, IPAM network creation, network performance reports, network infrastructure hardening, software/hardware licensing, and virtual network peering.
   

  

 Coordination of high\-impact infrastructure changes and outages during on and off\-hours.
   

  

 Collaboration with architecture teams providing design feedback, process improvement opportunities, and potential solution enhancements.
   

  

 Act as the escalation contact for the network helpdesk and incident managers.
   

  

 Communicate regularly with management and architecture teams on operational metrics.
   

  

 Light travel will be required to meet with international teams.
   

  

 Hands on support for the deployment of new infrastructure and maintenance of existing infrastructure at the company headquarters location.
   

  

 Be an advocate and change leader for network\-security initiatives and operational processes with a goal of improving the overall culture.
   

  

**Must\-have Qualifications, Skills, Experience**
 Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering or related field with 3\-5 years of networking and security experience.
   

  

 Advanced knowledge of LAN, WAN, VLAN, Public Cloud, Wireless, and VoIP networking technologies.
   

  

 Advance knowledge of routing protocols to include Border Gateway Protocol (BGP), Open Shortest Path First (OSPF), and Enhanced Interior Gateway Routing Protocol (EIGRP).
   

  

 Advanced knowledge of network security concepts, including web filters, NIDPS, DLP, SSL\-DPI, firewalls, etc.
   

  

 Advanced knowledge of network services, including DNS, DHCP, IPAM, SNMP, IPSec, NetFlow.
   

  

 Knowledge of Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) and Network Access Control (NAC) technologies.
   

  

 Knowledge of scripting, automation, and DevOps functions including Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) and Configuration\-as\-Code (CaC).
   

  

 Experience working with Fortinet, Cisco, InfoBlox, Microsoft Azure, and Amazon Web Services (AWS) technologies.
   

  

 Experience with client facing Network Operations Center (NOC) support.
   

  

 Advanced troubleshooting and diagnostic skills.
   

  

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
   

  

 Experience with ITSM, ITIL, NIST, CIS, and ISO 27001 frameworks.
   

  

 Proven ability to lead and manage multiple priorities with proven organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks with changing priorities.
   

  

 Experience with working with onshore and offshore global teams.
   

  

 Strong ability in multiple technologies, analytical techniques, and leadership skills.
   

  

 In\-depth knowledge of Operational Processes (Event, Incident, Change, Problem).
   

  

 Preferred Certifications:
   

  

 Microsoft Azure Certifications (AZ\-900, AZ\-700, AZ\-500, AZ\-204\)
   

  

 CompTIA \+ Certifications (Network\+, Security\+)
   

  

 Cisco Certifications (CCNA, CCNP)
   

  

**Educational Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
   

  

**Years Of Experience In This Field**
 3 to 7 years of experience as a Network Engineer in a global company.

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
 Job Title: IP Deployment Engineer
   

  

 Location:India
   

  

 We are seeking a IP Deployment Engineer to join our team, tasked with deploying and supporting one of the world's largest and most intricate networks. The ideal candidate is a proactive, quick learner, and highly motivated individual who thrives in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment. This role requires a creative problem\-solver who challenges the status quo and brings innovative solutions to everyday issues. The successful candidate will also possess excellent communication skills, capable of building strong relationships with internal teams and external partners such as vendors and contractors.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with Program Managers and Network Engineering to define site design requirements and develop project implementation and migration plans. This includes creating and reviewing deployment packages such as Engineering Design Packages (EDP), Scope of Works (SoW), Method of Procedures (MoP), Rack Face Elevations (RFE), and Bill of Materials (BoM).
* Provide technical leadership and guidance, both remotely and on\-site, for network upgrades and new PoP site builds. This covers areas like power, cooling, rack layout, cable management, equipment installation, network configuration, testing, and production traffic handoff.
* Calculate and document power and space requirements for equipment at multiple PoP sites. Coordinate with Colocation Vendors, local Engineering, and Facilities Operations to meet these requirements.
* Actively contribute to the improvement of documentation, automation, and processes.
* Design cages and racks, understanding the current and future needs of PoP infrastructure.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Over 5 years of experience in deploying and supporting network hardware platforms and architectures, including Cisco and/or Juniper routers/switches.
* Proficiency in configuring and troubleshooting IP routing/switching technologies and protocols such as TCP/IP, BGP, ISIS, OSPF, and MPLS in a dual\-stack IPv4/6 environment.
* Experience in coordinating and executing large\-scale hardware installations and configurations.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and execute complex network deployment projects with meticulous attention to detail.
* Strong interaction skills with vendors and external parties to ensure project completion.
* Experience with cage design using tools like MS Visio/Omnigraffle for layouts and rack elevations.
* Familiarity with Data Center electrical and cooling configurations (IEC, NEMA, AC/DC power, and power redundancy scenarios).
* Experience with Linux/OS tools.
* Ability to work effectively in a global team environment with minimal supervision.
* Preferred Qualifications:
* Certifications such as CCNP or JNCIP preferred; Expert\-level certifications are a plus.
* Experience with scripting and automation.
* Experience in coordinating and executing projects involving the deployment of optical communication equipment (DWDM), site preparations, and OTDR testing is desirable.


**Experience**
* 6\-8 Years


**Skills**
* Primary Skill: Network Engineer
* Sub Skill(s): Network Engineer
* Additional Skill(s): LAN, Network Operations, Firewall

**About Position**
 We are seeking an experienced Reconciliation Business Analyst (BA) to join our team in Pune. The ideal candidate will have deep domain expertise in banking reconciliations, hands\-on experience with reconciliation platforms (such as Duco, SmartStream TLM, or Intellimatch), and a proven track record of successfully delivering migration initiatives within investment banking or financial services environments. As a Reconciliation BA, you will play a critical role in migrating cash reconciliations from legacy platforms to a strategic reconciliation solution. You will work closely with Operations, IT, Finance, vendors, and program stakeholders to ensure accurate configuration, seamless migration execution, robust testing, and production\-ready documentation. This role demands strong analytical capability, detailed understanding of reconciliation logic, and the ability to translate complex legacy processes into scalable, future\-ready solutions.
   

  

* Role: Reconciliation BA
* Location: Pune
* Experience: 10 to 15 Years
* Job Type: Full Time Employment


**What You'll Do**
* The Reconciliation Migration Specialist will be responsible for migrating banking cash reconciliations from a legacy platform to the strategic reconciliation solution.
* The role will cover reconciliation development/configuration, migration execution, test support, defect resolution, and production grade technical documentation, working closely with Operations, IT, vendors, and programmed stakeholders.
* Proven experience delivering reconciliation migrations within an investment banking or financial services environment.

description:
**Description**
 About the Org:
   

  

 The Selling Partner Trust and Store Integrity's (TSI) vision is that bad actors cannot operate in our store while selling partners start and grow their business without fear of disruption, such that customers and selling partners across the globe trust us, and have confidence in the integrity of Amazon's store.
   

  

 Selling Partner Trust And Store Integrity's (TSI) Mission Is That We Build Trust By Protecting Customers, Selling Partners (SPs), And Our Store From Bad Actors And Ensuring SP Business Continuity By
   

  

* Proactively discouraging and preventing bad actors from operating in our store;
* Eliminating financial incentives from engaging in fraudulent and abusive behavior;
* Improving our speed and accuracy to identify and action bad actors, while ensuring we don't inadvertently disrupt SPs' business; and
* Building best\-in\-class experiences for SPs to sell in our store, understand and manage their business health, and remain compliant with Amazon's policies and external regulations.


**About The Team**
 The WW Customer Partner Trust (CPT) vision is to enable every brand — from the small business to the large multi\-national corporation — to thrive and grow into a global selling success. Our mission is to enable the long\-term success of our selling partners by providing the most trusted shopping and selling experience and powerful solutions for accelerating their business growth.
   

  

 We are entrusted with preventing fraud and abuse, and we are guardians for all our customers. We deliver at massive scale through technology, science, and expert human judgment while continuing to think even bigger about the future.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**Role**
 The CPT and Analytics (DEA) team is looking for a seasoned, highly analytical, and result\-oriented Business Analyst who can independently own and drive end\-to\-end analytics initiatives. This role requires someone who can:
   

  

* Lead the analysis of complex business problems and proactively identify opportunities for improvement
* Design and implement scalable analytical frameworks and reporting solutions
* Influence business strategy by translating data into actionable insights and presenting recommendations to senior leadership
* Mentor and raise the technical bar of the globally distributed analytics team
* Drive cross\-functional alignment by partnering with product, engineering, and science teams
* Provide deep data wrangling expertise and architect solutions for synthesizing very large, complex datasets


 We utilize multiple externally and internally (AWS and other) developed cutting\-edge data platforms, including real\-time and near\-real\-time platforms, to help create signal out of mountains of data.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

**Our Ideal Analyst**
* Has a track record of independently owning ambiguous, high\-impact analytical projects from scoping through delivery
* Enjoys discovering and solving complicated problems at scale
* Can quickly learn complex systems and identify systemic patterns
* Demonstrates strong judgment in prioritizing work and making trade\-offs
* Takes pride in organizing, documenting, and communicating their work to both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Has strong technical experience working with SQL, ETL pipelines, and tools like QuickSight/Tableau/Power BI
* Has experience working with Business Intelligence Engineers and Data Engineers to make sense of vast datasets

* Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
* Experience with Excel

title: Fullstack Engineer(Node.js, React)
description:
We are seeking a Senior Full\-Stack Developer to build and expand systems that connect enterprise data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake), AI decision engines, and Adobe Workfront workflow automation. You will operate at the intersection of application engineering, enterprise data architecture, AI optimization, and secure workflow governance. .
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* AI\-Enabled Platform Architecture
* Build and develop scalable RESTful APIs that power AI\-assisted enterprise workflows.
* Incorporate and manage pre\-trained AI models within secure production settings.
* Implement agentic AI workflows that complete multi\-step business processes using existing models.
* Debug, tune, and harden AI model behavior (accuracy, determinism, latency, cost).
* Apply model optimization strategies (timely composition, caching, routing, guardrails).
* Build and operate AI orchestration layers (context management, tool access, policy enforcement).
* Evaluate and implement RAG or prompt\-based architectures where appropriate (no new model training).
* Enterprise Data Integration
* Integrate applications and AI services with Databricks and Snowflake for large\-scale operational decisioning.
* Build governed data access layers optimized for performance, security, and reliability.
* Enable secure integration with CRM, GTM, and operational systems.
* Deliver systems capable of operating in restricted or air\-gapped environments.
* Workflow Orchestration (Workfront)
* Build and implement Adobe Workfront integrations to automate enterprise workflows.
* Build custom Workfront API integrations and Fusion scenarios.
* Align Workfront orchestration with decision layers powered by advanced technology.
* Ensure workflow governance, permissioning, and enterprise compliance standards are upheld.
* Engineering Excellence
* Build modern full\-stack applications using scalable frontend and backend technologies.
* Ensure systems meet enterprise standards for reliability, observability, and security.
* Partner multi\-functionally with Strategy \& Ops, Sales, and Engineering leaders to translate business needs into scalable architecture.


**Experience**
**What We’re Looking For**
* 7–10\+ years of experience as a Full\-Stack Developer in enterprise SaaS or large\-scale systems environments.
* Demonstrable experience crafting and operating RESTful APIs in production.
* Experience delivering systems in secure or regulated enterprise environments.


**Technical Expertise**
* Proficiency in Node.js, Java, or Python.
* Experience integrating with Databricks and/or Snowflake.
* Demonstrated experience incorporating and managing pre\-trained AI models in production.
* Strong expertise in AI model debugging and optimization (not model development).
* Experience implementing AI orchestration patterns, timely engineering, and RAG workflows.
* Solid understanding of distributed systems, scalability, and performance tuning.


**Workfront Requirements**
* Adobe Workfront Certified Developer (required or strongly preferred).
* Experience building custom Workfront integrations via API and Workfront Fusion.
* Solid understanding of workflow governance and enterprise configuration within Workfront.


**Approach**
* Systems thinker with architectural judgment.
* Bias toward production reliability over experimentation.
* Strong multi\-functional collaboration skills.
* Ability to translate ambiguity into scalable technical build.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with Adobe Experience Platform.
* Experience with vector databases and retrieval\-based architectures.
* Experience supporting sales, GTM, or revenue operations platforms.
* Experience with AI observability and governance tooling.


**About Adobe**
 Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry\-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
   

  

 Our 30,000\+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.
   

  

**Let’s Adobe together**
 At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.
   

  

 Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.
   

  

 Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com or call \+1 408\-536\-3015\.

* Improve existing UI functionality on a variety of products
* Build reusable code for future use
* Cross\-team communications with stakeholders to understand implementation requirements and limitations
* Provide mentorship to peers in the broader engineering team through code reviews and promoting best practices

You will provide specialist case management advice and coaching to People Leaders across UK on a variety of topics and drive the resolution of Disciplinary, Capability \& Grievance cases, with managers.
   

  

 To be successful as an “ER Case Management Global Support Advisor”, you should have experience with:
   

  

**Required Skills**
* Practical ER Case management experience gained in an HR/ER function advising Line Managers on a day\-to\-day basis on ER Cases in a commercial and pragmatic way.
* Prior experience of practical ER case management or advisory on complex matters for a medium to large blue chip organization. Experience managing HR/ER matters across UK would be an added advantage.

* Influencing and stakeholder management skills.

**Additional Skills**

 To support the business with the management of employee relations cases, in line with relevant policies, procedures and regulatory requirements. title: Specialist/Senior Specialist – Global Lateral Sourcing – International Human Resources Operations and Projects – Human Capital
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $90 billion in investment capital as of March 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world’s capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
   

  

 We are looking for talented and insightful candidates to join our Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram offices as a Specialist/Senior Specialist in our International Human Resources Operations and Projects (IHOP) group, which is part of the Talent Acquisition (TA) team. This role offers a challenging work environment and excellent opportunities to learn and grow within the Human Capital function. The candidate will collaborate with key stakeholders across global geographies in talent sourcing and support the firm’s recruitment efforts.
   

  

 WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY\-TO\-DAY:
   

  

 In this role, you will play a pivotal role in drafting and executing talent sourcing strategies by partnering with the Global Recruitment team to identify candidates for various positions throughout the firm. You will conduct intake meetings with the global recruitment team to understand the required skills, create sourcing strategies, and identify talent pool availability in alignment with the global recruitment team. Additionally, you will execute sourcing strategies across professional networks, academic databases, and internet research, sharing observations and challenges with stakeholders in real\-time. You will also provide market intelligence and sourcing insights to recruitment partners, manage candidate data and interaction history within our CRM (GEM) and ATS (iCIMS) platforms with accuracy, conduct candidate rediscovery from our CRM and ATS to maximize the value of the existing talent database, and identify opportunities to implement automation (external tools and Gen AI) in the process to automate repetitive tasks. Furthermore, you will be responsible for managing complex data sets as a part of talent research while maintaining high standards of quality.
   

  

 WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:
   

  

 The ideal candidate should hold:
   

  

 Basic qualifications:
   

  

* A graduate/master’s degree with 2 to 5 years of relevant work experience in a global sourcing/recruitment role
* Proven work experience as a talent sourcer, partnering with global recruiting teams, with demonstrated success in developing candidate pipelines for complex positions through professional sites, internet searches, and resume databases
* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to engage with global recruitment teams


 Preferred qualifications:
   

  

* Genuine curiosity about staying updated with Gen AI developments and their implementation in talent acquisition processes


 Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/SpSrSpIHOPFeb26
   

  

 We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender\-neutral return\-to\-work initiative.
   

  

 The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers.
   

  

 Members of the D. E. Shaw group do not discriminate in employment matters on the basis of sex, race, colour, caste, creed, religion, pregnancy, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other protected class.

title: Data Analytics Delivery Lead
description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues \- experts in their fields \- who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients \- who are at the heart of everything we do. Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.

**Job Description:**

**Are you ready to shine?**

*At Sun Life, we empower you to be your most brilliant self.*

**Who we are?**

**Sun Life** is a leading financial services company with history of 150\+ years that helps our clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives.


We serve millions in Canada, the U.S., Asia, the U.K., and other parts of the world. We have a network of Sun Life advisors, third\-party partners, and other distributors. Through them, we’re helping set our clients free to live their lives their way, from now through retirement. We’re working hard to support their wellness and health management goals, too. That way, they can enjoy what matters most to them. And that’s anything from running a marathon to helping their grandchildren learn to ride a bike.


To do this, we offer a broad range of protection and wealth products and services to individuals, businesses, and institutions, including:

* **Insurance.** Life, health, wellness, disability, critical illness, stop\-loss, and long\-term care insurance.
* **Investments.** Mutual funds, segregated funds, annuities, and guaranteed investment products
* **Advice.** Financial planning and retirement planning services
* **Asset management.** Pooled funds, institutional portfolios, and pension funds


With innovative technology, a strong distribution network and long\-standing relationships with some of the world’s largest employers, we are today providing financial security to millions of people globally.


Sun Life is a leading financial services company that helps our clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives, with strong insurance, asset management, investments, and financial advice portfolios. At Sun Life, our asset management business draws on the talent and experience of professionals from around the globe.

**Sun Life Global Solutions (SLGS)**


Established in the Philippines in 1991 and in India in 2006, Sun Life Global Solutions, (formerly Asia Service Centres), a microcosm of Sun Life, is poised to harness the regions’ potential in a significant way \- from India and the Philippines to the world. We are architecting and executing a BOLDER vision: being a Digital and Innovation Hub, shaping the Business, driving Transformation and superior Client experience by providing expert Technology, Business and Knowledge Services and advanced Solutions. We help our clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives – our core purpose and mission.


Drawing on our collaborative and inclusive culture, we are reckoned as a ‘Great Place to Work’, ‘Top 100 Best Places to Work for Women’ and stand among the ‘Top 11 Global Business Services Companies’ across India and the Philippines.


The technology function at Sun Life Global Solutions is geared towards growing our existing business, deepening our client understanding, managing new\-age technology systems, and demonstrating thought leadership. We are committed to building greater domain expertise and engineering ability, delivering end to end solutions for our clients, and taking a lead in intelligent automation. Tech services at Sun Life Global Solutions have evolved in areas such as application development and management, Support, Testing, Digital, Data Engineering and Analytics, Infrastructure Services and Project Management.

 Fictiv is a global manufacturing and supply chain company that enables organizations to scale globally across Fictiv’s four global manufacturing centers in India, Mexico, China, and the U.S.. Companies use Fictiv to access high\-quality production, optimize supply chain logistics, and mitigate supply chain risk—ensuring they can move from prototype to full\-scale manufacturing with speed and confidence. To date, Fictiv has delivered more than 35 million commercial and prototype parts for industries such as aerospace, robotics, automotive, climate tech, and more, helping them innovate faster, free up precious resources, and drive profitable growth.
   

  

 What’s in it for you?
   

  

**Opportunity To Unlock Your Creativity**
 Think of all the times you were held back from trying new ideas because you were boxed in by bureaucratic legacy processes or old school tactics. Having a growth mindset is deeply ingrained into our company culture since day 1 so Fictiv is an environment where you have the creative liberty and support of the team to try big bold ideas to achieve our sales and customer goals.
   

  

**Opportunity To Grow Your Career**
 There are plenty of jobs out there. The question is whether any of them will help you grow in your career? Will you be challenged by teammates to achieve your potential? Or are they roles that will ask you to do more of what you’ve already mastered. At Fictiv, you’ll be surrounded by supportive teammates who will push you to be your best through their curiosity and passion.
   

  

**Impact In This Role**
 Fictiv is a fast growing start\-up based in San\-Francisco, California \- it was founded in 2013 and is revolutionising the $13 trillion manufacturing industry with a cloud\-based, AI\-powered platform. Fictiv’s software driven approach to manufacturing simplifies and accelerates the entire product development cycle, from prototype to production. The Fictiv Digital Manufacturing Ecosystem pairs intelligent workflow and collaboration software with a global network of highly vetted manufacturers. Fictiv’s combination of an easy\-to\-use cloud platform; design, quoting, billing and logistics systems; and an intelligent orchestration engine that manages our manufacturing partner network helps deliver high\-quality mechanical parts at unprecedented speeds. At a time when manufacturing has become more global but remains rooted in outdated and time\-intensive processes, Fictiv’s modern approach has proven to be a disruptive force in hardware manufacturing. Embraced as a trusted partner, Fictiv is transforming the way in which Silicon Valley innovators in electric and autonomous automobiles, medical robotics and consumer electronics deliver the next generation of products.
   

  

 Fictiv is expanding it’s engineering team in Pune, India \- we are looking for talented engineers to join us in building a highly available, performant system that scales globally with our fast\-growing business.

* Proficiency with building backend APIs and integrations
* Experience and willingness to write unit and integration tests
* Experience developing/versioning/maintaining REST or GraphQL APIs
* Experience with SQL \& No\-SQL databases
* Experience with event systems such as queues, iPaaS, event buses
* Experience with distributed systems / caching / security (OWASP Top 10\) is a strong plus

People who succeed at Fictiv are talented, creative, and driven to achieve professional excellence and support our vision to help product innovators create.
   

  

 We’re actively seeking teammates who:
   

  

* Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.

title: People Operations Lead (Talent & Org Systems)
description:
**Location:** Bangalore **Experience:** 2\-5 years **Type:** Full\-time \| On\-site **Start:** Immediate

**Why this role exists**

Most companies think HR is about policies.It isn’t.

It’s about building a system where **great people join, stay, perform, and scale**.

We are at a stage where hiring, performance, and culture cannot depend on founders anymore.This role exists to build a **repeatable, investor\-grade people engine**.

**What you’ll do**

You will not “manage HR.”You will **design and run the operating system for people.**

**1\. Build a high\-performance hiring engine**

* Own hiring across functions (engineering, GTM, ops)
* Design structured hiring processes (scorecards, interview loops, decision frameworks)
* Ensure quality of hire improves over time, not just speed
* Build pipelines for leadership hiring (not just execution roles)

**2\. Design compensation \& ownership frameworks**

* Build clear, defensible **compensation bands**
* Create an **ESOP framework** aligned with long\-term value creation
* Ensure all comp decisions can withstand **Series A investor scrutiny**

**3\. Create a world\-class onboarding system**

* Design onboarding that drives **productivity in weeks, not months**
* Standardize onboarding playbooks across roles
* Track onboarding success through measurable outcomes

**4\. Own performance management**

* Design and run performance review cycles
* Create clarity on:
* What good looks like
* How performance is measured
* How decisions are made (promotions, exits, rewards)
* Enable managers to run high\-quality performance conversations

**5\. Build team health \& operating rhythm**

* Own:
* Leave management
* Team well\-being
* Feedback loops
* Identify early signals of:
* Burnout
* Misalignment
* Performance drift
* Intervene before problems become visible

**6\. Develop leadership pipeline**

* Identify and hire future leaders
* Work with founders to define leadership expectations
* Build succession depth across teams

**7\. Create an intern\-to\-full\-time talent engine**

* Design structured intern programs
* Train interns into deployable talent
* Build a **bench of pre\-trained candidates** ready for rapid hiring

**What success looks like**

* Hiring becomes **predictable, high\-quality, and fast**
* New hires become productive within **weeks**
* Compensation and ESOP structures are **clear and defensible**
* Performance reviews are **objective and trusted**
* Team health issues are **caught early and resolved**
* There is always a **ready talent pipeline (interns \+ leadership)**

**Who you are**

* You have **2\-5 years of experience in people operations / talent**
* You have built or scaled **hiring and people systems**, not just executed processes
* You think in **systems and frameworks**, not policies
* You are comfortable working closely with founders and influencing decisions
* You care deeply about **performance, not just culture optics**

**What will make you stand out**

* Experience in high\-growth startups (Series A/B stage)
* Designed comp/ESOP frameworks from scratch
* Built structured hiring and performance systems
* Worked on leadership hiring and org design
* Can combine **data \+ judgment** in people decisions

**Why join**

* You will build the **people foundation of a scaling company**
* Your work directly impacts **team quality, speed, and culture**
* You will operate close to leadership and influence core decisions

**What this role is not**

* Not an admin or policy management role
* Not limited to payroll, compliance, or coordination
* Not reactive HR support

**What this role is**

* A **builder of systems**
* A **guardian of talent quality**
* A **multiplier of team performance**

title: Area HR Partner (North & East)
description:
SPEED \& SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.
  
**Your mission**
----------------


Reports to: Senior Manager HR (Retail North \& East)


Position Summary: The Retail HR role partners closely with retail operations to support people\-related initiatives across stores. The role focuses on driving hiring, employee engagement, capability development, and compliance while building a strong connect with store teams and supporting the overall employee experience in the region.


Key Objectives:

* Manage the end\-to\-end employee lifecycle for retail employees including recruitment, onboarding, engagement initiatives, training and development, and exit interviews.
* Drive hiring across retail stores by identifying and leveraging both internal and external recruitment sources to ensure timely closure of open positions.
* Partner with retail operations stakeholders and store managers to understand manpower requirements and support people\-related decisions across stores.
* Assess behavioral and capability development needs of store employees and coordinate relevant training programs with internal or external trainers.
* Plan and manage the monthly employee engagement calendar across stores to strengthen employee connect and morale.
* Coordinate and ensure timely and accurate submission of payroll inputs for retail employees.
* Conduct regular store visits to interact with employees, gather feedback, understand on\-ground challenges, and support resolution of employee concerns.
* Track attrition trends and employee feedback across stores and work with business leaders to drive retention and employee experience initiatives.
* Ensure effective implementation of company policies across stores and monitor compliance with statutory requirements, including maintenance of statutory registers and documentation.
* Actively participate in various company forums and people initiatives within the organization.


**Your talent**
---------------


Eligibility Criteria And Functional Competencies Required:

* MBA / PGDM students specializing in HR or related fields.
* 2–4 years of HR experience, preferably in retail, hospitality, or other customer\-facing industries.
* Prior experience in managing store hiring, employee engagement, and HR operations will be an advantage.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel and PowerPoint.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and work with multiple stakeholders.


**Our principles**
------------------


PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.


At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity \- no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people \-with real judgment and accountability. We may use functions supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to carry out isolated organizational steps, such as scheduling interviews. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play.


PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120\+ countries, and has around 22,000 employees worldwide.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Role Purpose**


The Engineering Manager (EM) is the single point of accountability for people leadership, delivery outcomes, and engineering practices across 2–3 Scrum teams within an Encompass release train. The EM provides direct people leadership for Encompass engineers, day\-to\-day work management and structured feedback for partner/other\-org developers, and drives adoption of AI\-native engineering practices across Development, Test, Release, Deployment \& Documentation, and AI Adoption in Engineering. Each EM also acts as Primary Practice Lead for one of these practices, running the relevant practice cohort (community of practice) and ensuring consistent, high\-quality, AI\-enabled ways of working that align with Encompass Engineering’s strategy and Engineering Culture.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. People Leadership \& Staff Management**

* Act as people manager for approximately 15–20 engineers across 2–3 Scrum teams, owning hiring, onboarding, performance management, compensation input, and promotion recommendations.
* Set clear expectations and goals; provide regular coaching, feedback, and career development support for Encompass engineers.
* Conduct end\-of\-PI and quarterly reviews and annual performance appraisals in line with CSG processes.
* Provide structured work and performance feedback for partner/other\-org developers into their home line managers.
* Foster a healthy, inclusive culture in a predominantly remote, globally distributed environment, promoting psychological safety, collaboration, and constructive feedback.

**2\. Delivery Responsibility (2–3 Scrum Teams per ART)**

* Be accountable for delivery outcomes across 2–3 Scrum teams within a release train, including predictability against PI and iteration objectives, sustainable throughput, and quality.
* Partner with Technical Leads and Scrum teams to ensure PI and sprint plans are realistic, achievable, and aligned to team capacity and skills.
* Ensure teams are adhering to Encompass Engineering’s Engineering Culture and agreed practices across development, testing, release, documentation, and AI.
* Review and confirm teams’ PI and iteration plans and commitments before sign\-off.
* Monitor, track, and manage teams’ progress, risks, and issues, escalating and removing impediments requiring leadership action.

**3\. Engineering Practices \& Practice Leadership**

* Own and continuously improve engineering practices and standards across the four core practices: Development, Test, Release, Deployment \& Documentation, and AI Adoption in Engineering.
* Serve as Primary Practice Lead for one practice (and potentially Secondary Lead for another), running the relevant practice cohort/community of practice.
* Translate Strategic Architect and System Architect vision and guardrails into practical standards, templates, and playbooks usable by teams.
* Plan practice\-related work and capacity (frameworks, tools, training, documentation, AI patterns) and work with RTE/Scrum Masters to secure and visualise that capacity in PI and sprint plans.
* Track practice health metrics (e.g., automation coverage, documentation completeness, CI/CD health, AI usage and impact, change failure rate) and drive targeted improvements.

**4\. AI\-First Engineering Ways of Working**

* Promote responsible, human\-in\-the\-loop use of AI tools (e.g., Cursor, Glean, AI\-assisted test frameworks) for coding, testing, analysis, and documentation.
* Ensure AI usage adheres to security, privacy, compliance, and quality guardrails defined by the Strategic Architect Group.
* Embed AI\-assisted workflows into daily engineering practices (development, testing, debugging, documentation) to improve productivity and quality.
* Measure the impact of AI on productivity and quality and refine patterns, prompts, and training based on data and feedback.

**5\. Team Composition, Capability \& Collaboration**

* Shape team composition across 2–3 Scrum teams to optimise skills, experience, domain knowledge, growth opportunities, and resilience to attrition.
* Ensure effective Scrum Masters (in the Product Group) and Technical Leads are in place and operating to expectation.
* Collaborate closely with Product Owners, RTE/ART leadership, Architecture, HR, Talent and Finance on backlog prioritisation, capacity planning, workforce planning, and people programs.
* Support and participate in communities of practice (developers, testers, AI, etc.) and organisation\-wide initiatives across Bangalore and globally.

**Required Experience \& Qualifications**

* **Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* **Experience**
* 8\+ years in software engineering roles (Developer, SDET, or similar).
* 3\+ years in a people\-leadership role (Engineering Manager, Team Lead, or equivalent), ideally leading multiple Agile teams.
* Demonstrated success delivering outcomes across multiple Scrum teams in an Agile/SAFe environment.
* Proven experience implementing and improving engineering practices (coding standards, testing, CI/CD, documentation).
* Experience managing risks and issues in complex, distributed programs and leading and developing engineers across locations.
* **Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong understanding of Agile/SAFe (Scrum, PI planning, ARTs, RTE, SM, PO roles).
* Ability to lead and inspire remote, cross\-functional engineering teams based in Bangalore and globally.
* Strong partnership skills with Product, Architecture, Agile/Program leadership, HR, and other stakeholders.
* Comfort using data and metrics to drive decisions on delivery, quality, and practice health.
* Familiarity with modern engineering practices (code reviews, trunk\-based development, automated testing, CI/CD) and operational practices (monitoring, logging, incident response, runbooks).
* Interest and aptitude in AI\-assisted engineering tools and concepts, with a willingness to learn and adopt new capabilities.
* Excellent communication skills in formal business English, with the ability to operate across time zones and cultures.

Cimpress Technology develops cutting\-edge, best\-in\-world software that our mass customization businesses use to create personalized products for millions of global customers. **Our Team :**



The Cimpress Operations Specialist team will be established to support the end\-to\-end operational lifecycle across Cimpress businesses, ensuring seamless execution across product, fulfillment, manufacturing, and logistics operations in alignment with Cimpress platform standards.



This team will act as an extension of Cimpress operational and platform resources within Cimpress Technology and the individual Cimpress businesses, driving operational excellence across the full business lifecycle from configuration to production and fulfillment migration.

* Standards \& Operations Curator – Responsible for creating, updating, and governing operational standards and workflows across Cimpress businesses

To be effective in this role, team members must develop a strong understanding of individual business operations, fulfillment flows, manufacturing processes, and the Cimpress platform standards that govern them.

We have a Remote\-First operating model and culture, with team members in over 15 countries and 30 US states, offering autonomy and the flexibility to work from home. Cimpress also provides collaboration spaces for team members to work physically together.


### **About Us :**



Led by founder and CEO Robert Keane, Cimpress invests in and helps build customer\-focused, entrepreneurial mass customization businesses. Cimpress Technology develops cutting\-edge, best\-in\-world software that our mass customization businesses use to create personalized physical (and digital) products, for over 17 million global customers. Our businesses can choose the solutions that work for them, or assemble any custom combination they need. This makes it easier and faster to do things like introduce new products, reach customers and track orders. And this kind of innovation keeps customers coming back.


### **Commitment to Diversity, Equity, \& Inclusion :**



Cimpress exists to help our customers live their dreams. Each dream is unique – and the Cimpress team needs to be as well. We believe in the unique contributions of everyone within a diverse global organization. We are collaborative, inclusive, and innovative. We strive to role model and live an inclusive culture of fairness, respect and belonging for all. And we work together to empower each other, creating a space in which each of us can spark our next great idea.


### **Equal Opportunity Employer :**



Cimpress Technology, a Cimpress company, is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, national or ethnic origin, nationality, age, religion, citizenship, disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender presentation, legal or preferred name, marital status, pregnancy, family structure, veteran status or any other basis protected by human rights laws or regulations. This list is not exhaustive and, in fact, in many cases, we strive to do more than the law requires.



Global corporate Website –  



  

**Skills**

* Fulfillment \& manufacturing configuration/migration

Good to have: supply chain/e\-commerce experience, image editing basics, exposure to AI/tools

Founded in 1995, Cimpress empowers millions of customers around the world to make an impression through personalized, high\-quality printed and custom products. * **Business Partnering:** Collaborate with the People Team and business leaders to provide data\-driven insights and practical advice on reward solutions that support organisational goals and enhance employee experience.
* **Policy Development:** Support the development and maintenance of reward and benefit policies that are transparent, equitable, and consistent with LRQA’s values and governance standards.
* **Benefit Renewals:** Assist with benefit renewals globally, including data preparation and ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and alignment with business priorities.
* **Employee Communication:** Contribute to the creation of clear and engaging communication materials that help employees understand and appreciate their total reward package.
* **Data Management:** Maintain accurate and compliant records of reward and benefits data, supporting audit processes and regulatory reporting requirements.
* **Benchmarking \& Surveys:** Participate in benefits surveys, analyse market data, and provide recommendations to maintain competitive positioning.
* **Stakeholder Support:** Respond to benefit\-related queries from employees, People teams and business leaders, providing clear and timely guidance.
* **Vendor Support:** Liaise with insurance providers and brokers for renewals , employee issues and process improvements
* **Project Management:** Assist in the planning and execution of reward\-related projects, ensuring delivery within scope, budget, and timelines.
* **Drive Process Improvements:** Identify inefficiencies in reward operations and propose solutions to streamline workflows and improve service delivery.
* **Benefits Administration:** Assist with enrolment cycles, preparing business cases for approval, preparing data and dealing with invoices for vendor payments.

  


**Skills**

* **Pro\-active mindset:** Anticipates needs, identifies potential issues early and takes the initiative to drive solutions without waiting for direction.
* **Analytical Thinking:** Applies data\-driven insights to support benefit decisions, identify trends, and ensure accuracy in benchmarking and reporting.
* **Stakeholder Engagement:** Builds strong relationships, providing clear and timely advice on reward matters.
* **Communication:** Communicates complex reward concepts effectively, tailoring messages to diverse audiences and supporting employee understanding.
* **Process Management:** Supports cyclical reward activities and contributes to continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring operational efficiency and compliance.
* **Market Awareness:** Monitors external trends and legislative developments to inform benchmarking and maintain competitive positioning.
* **Systems Proficiency:** Demonstrates working knowledge of HRIS platforms (e.g., SuccessFactors) and data tools (e.g., Excel), ensuring data accuracy and supporting system enhancements.
* **Governance \& Compliance:** Maintains awareness of regulatory requirements and ensures reward practices meet internal and external standards.
* **Project Support:** Contributes to the planning and delivery of reward\-related projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives and timelines.

  


**Experience and qualification**

* **Educational Background:** Educated to university degree level in a relevant field such as Human Resources, Business, Finance, or Economics. A professional qualification in reward, compensation, or benefits is advantageous but not essential.
* **Professional Experience:** 2\+ years of experience in a reward or benefits role, ideally within a global or complex organisational environment. Familiarity with cyclical reward activities such as benefit renewals is preferred.
* **Technical Knowledge:** Experience working with HRIS platforms (e.g., SuccessFactors) and confident to use vendor platforms.
* **Analytical Capability:** Demonstrates analytical mindset with the ability to interpret complex data ad summarise findings.
* **Communication Skills:** Communicates clearly and effectively with stakeholders at all levels, supporting understanding of reward programmes and contributing to employee engagement.
* **Digital Proficiency:** Skilled in Microsoft Office applications, with specific proficiency in Excel to support data analysis and reporting.
* **Language Skills:** Fluent in written and spoken English. Additional language fluency is beneficial but not required.

  



**Pre\-Employment Checks**

* If you are successful in securing a role with us, you will be subject to pre\-employment checks, depending on the legal requirements and practices in your country of employment.
* If eligible these checks will include right to work, identification, verification of employment history, education, and criminal records where permitted by local law.
* All checks will be conducted in accordance with applicable privacy and data protection regulations.
* We will involve the third party supplier to run the background checks as needed and your data will be retained for a period as needed for the purpose of recruitment.

title: HR Compliance Background Investigations Analyst
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**Overview**


The India HR Compliance Background Investigations Analyst will play a vital role in leading compliant, risk\-based background check screening processes while ensuring adherence to applicable employment laws and data privacy regulations. As part of the Background Investigations team, this role serves as a subject matter expert on background investigations and hiring compliance, partnering cross\-functionally to manage risk, interpreting complex findings, and upholding the firm’s regulatory and ethical standards. The role ensures consistent and timely execution of background investigations in accordance with applicable firm policies and screening requirements, while applying sound judgement to identify and appropriately escalate complex, ambiguous, and time\-sensitive cases.


This position requires strong regulatory knowledge and critical thinking skills, analytical judgement, the highest level of confidentiality and discretion, and the ability to operate effectively and efficiently in a fast\-evolving compliance landscape.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Background Investigations**

* Coordinate and facilitate pre\-employment background checks for India\-based hires primarily, as well as internal promotions, contractors, and client\-specific engagements.
* Liaise with external background check vendors to ensure accurate, compliant, and timely processing of investigations.
* Review and adjudicate background check results against firm standards and legal requirements, while applying sound risk\-based judgement, and escalating complex findings as appropriate.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partners, and Legal to manage exceptions, escalations, and adverse action processes.
* Continuously identify ways to enhance background investigation policies, controls, processes, vendor governance, and candidate experience.

**Compliance Oversight**

* Maintain detailed knowledge and subject matter expertise in Indian employment and data privacy laws related to compliance with hiring and background investigations (e.g., Shops \& Establishments Acts, Aadhaar restrictions, Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP), as well as knowledge of relevant U.S. and global regulations (e.g., Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), Fair Chance Acts, GDPR, etc.).
* Monitor legislative changes and emerging industry risks impacting hiring compliance.
* Identify and proactively recommend controls to mitigate evolving risks within the hiring and background screening landscape including resume fraud, credential misrepresentation, synthetic identities, AI\-enabled candidate impersonation, automated application bots, and misuse of generative AI during interviews.
* Ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulatory requirements related to pre\-employment processes and adverse action.

**Training \& Education**

* Develop and deliver training for HR teams, hiring managers, and other stakeholders on background check processes and compliance obligations.
* Act as a trusted advisor on compliance best practices to minimize organizational risk.

**Documentation \& Reporting**

* Maintain complete, accurate, and audit\-ready background check records, communications, and compliance documentation.
* Prepare reports and dashboards on compliance activities, background check trends, audit findings, and metrics.

**Communication**

* Provide clear, timely, and relevant communication to candidates, employees, and other key stakeholders regarding background check results and compliance requirements.
* Handle all background check reports and sensitive information with the highest level of discretion, confidentiality, and professionalism, and on a strict need\-to\-know basis.

**Qualifications \& Requirements**

**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Legal Studies, or related field.
* 3–5\+ years of relevant HR compliance, background investigations, or related experience.
* Experience within professional services, consulting, or multinational organizations preferred.

**Specialized Knowledge**

* Strong knowledge of employment law, compliance frameworks, and regulatory requirements.
* Sound understanding and familiarity with Shops \& Establishments Acts, Aadhar regulations, FCRA, Fair Chance Acts, DPDP, GDPR, and global data privacy and compliance standards as it relates to employment and background investigations.
* Experience with HRIS systems, applicant tracking systems, and background screening tools.

**Core Competencies**

* **Judgement and Integrity:** Demonstrates strong ethical and sound decision\-making and uses the highest level of discretion and confidentiality in sensitive matters.
* **Analytical \& Problem\-Solving:** Ability to interpret complex data and resolve issues with minimal supervision.
* **Collaboration \& Communication:** Builds strong cross\-functional partnerships and communicates clearly, timely and effectively, both written and verbal.
* **Adaptability:** Operates effectively in dynamic, fast\-paced, evolving regulatory environments, and is comfortable with managing ambiguity and complexity while supporting change initiatives.
* **Operational Excellence:** Exceptional organizational, time management, and project management skills with strong attention to detail and a focus on accuracy and compliance.
* **Technical Proficiency**: Proficiency in HRIS and background check tools, Microsoft Office, data reporting, and AI tools.

**Preferred/Additional Requirements**

* Professional certification in HR compliance, employment law, or related field (e.g., HRCI, SHRM, XLRI, CCEP, etc.).
* Demonstrated ability to manage sensitive investigations or escalations with discretion.
* Global compliance experience (e.g., cross\-border background checks and compliance).
* Strong data analysis and reporting skills (Power BI, Tableau, or advanced Excel).


We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

**Our Benefits:**  

At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!  

  

**How You Can Grow:**  

We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!  

  

**More about Crowe:**


Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.


Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third\-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre\-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.


We are committed to a merit\-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job\-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

title: HR Executive
description:
**Role Overview:**

We are looking for a proactive and dynamic Human Resource Executive to join our team and contribute to the success of our people operations. In this role, you will be responsible for managing the full employee lifecycle, from recruitment and onboarding to employee engagement and compliance. You will play a key part in fostering a high\-performing culture, supporting the HR department, and ensuring that HR processes are executed efficiently and effectively. If you are passionate about people management and enjoy working in a collaborative environment, we’d love to hear from you!

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **End\-to\-End Recruitment:** Manage the recruitment process from start to finish. This includes sourcing, screening, and shortlisting candidates, scheduling and conducting interviews, coordinating with hiring managers, and ensuring a smooth and efficient recruitment process. Work with various teams to understand their staffing needs and proactively source talent across multiple channels.
* **Onboarding \& Employee Records:** Oversee the onboarding process for new employees, ensuring that they have a seamless experience from day one. Handle all documentation, including offer letters, contracts, and other onboarding paperwork. Ensure that employee records are maintained accurately and are up\-to\-date in the HRIS (Human Resource Information System).
* **HRIS Administration \& Attendance Management:** Administer and maintain the HRIS system, ensuring that all employee data is recorded, updated, and easily accessible. Track and manage employee attendance, absences, and leave requests, ensuring that all processes align with company policies and legal requirements.
* **Payroll Support \& Statutory Compliance:** Assist with payroll processing, ensuring timely and accurate payment of salaries, bonuses, and incentives. Support the HR team in handling statutory compliance matters such as Provident Fund (PF), Employee State Insurance (ESI), and other relevant labor laws. Ensure all payroll\-related documentation is complete and compliant with local regulations.
* **Employee Engagement \& Team Building:** Help organize and manage employee engagement initiatives, team\-building activities, and other events that foster a positive and inclusive workplace culture. Encourage employee participation in events and collaborate with teams to improve overall employee satisfaction and morale.
* **Performance Management Support:** Assist in the performance management process, including coordinating feedback sessions, assisting with performance appraisals, and helping employees set development goals. Maintain records of performance reviews and ensure that they are conducted on time.
* **HR Policy Support:** Support the implementation and communication of company policies, procedures, and guidelines. Ensure that all employees are aware of their rights and responsibilities in the workplace and assist with any employee queries regarding HR policies.
* **Employee Grievance Handling:** Provide support in addressing employee concerns and grievances in a timely and professional manner. Ensure that any issues are escalated and handled according to company policies and best practices.
* **Employee Exit Process:** Manage the exit process for departing employees, including conducting exit interviews, handling resignation or termination paperwork, and ensuring that all formalities are completed smoothly. Provide insights from exit interviews to improve organizational practices.

**Required Skills:**

* **Recruitment \& Sourcing:** Experience in managing the full recruitment cycle, including candidate sourcing, screening resumes, conducting interviews, and working with hiring managers to select the best candidates for the role. Familiarity with various job boards, recruitment tools, and social media platforms for sourcing talent.
* **Onboarding \& Documentation:** Knowledge of employee onboarding processes, including preparing offer letters, contracts, and other essential documentation. Ability to ensure a smooth onboarding experience for new hires and help them integrate into the company culture.
* **HRMS (Human Resource Management System):** Proficiency in using HRMS platforms to manage employee data, track attendance, leave, and other HR\-related tasks. Experience with tools like BambooHR, Zoho People, or other HR software is a plus.
* **Compliance \& Payroll Support:** Understanding of statutory compliance, labor laws, and payroll\-related activities. Experience in assisting with payroll processing and ensuring compliance with government regulations, such as PF, ESI, and gratuity.
* **People Management:** Ability to build positive relationships with employees and management, providing guidance and support across all HR\-related functions. Strong interpersonal skills to collaborate with employees at all levels.
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to communicate effectively with employees, management, and external parties. Strong listening skills and the ability to provide clear and concise information.
* **Problem\-Solving \& Multitasking:** Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities while remaining detail\-oriented. Strong problem\-solving skills to address employee concerns, recruitment challenges, and compliance issues effectively.

**Nice\-to\-Have Skills:**

* **HR Analytics:** Familiarity with HR analytics and reporting tools to provide insights into HR metrics, such as turnover rates, employee engagement, and recruitment success.
* **Knowledge of Employee Benefits:** Understanding of employee benefits programs (e.g., health insurance, leave policies, retirement benefits) and experience in administering these programs.
* **Workforce Planning:** Knowledge of workforce planning and organizational development principles. Ability to anticipate future hiring needs and assist with talent management strategies.

**Personal Attributes:**

* **Detail\-Oriented \& Organized:** Ability to manage large volumes of information accurately and stay organized in a fast\-paced environment. Attention to detail is essential for handling employee records, payroll, and compliance documentation.
* **Adaptable \& Resilient:** Ability to adapt to changing business needs and work effectively under pressure. Willingness to take on new challenges and responsibilities as the company grows.
* **Team Player:** Collaborative and supportive in working with various departments. Ability to contribute to a positive and productive work environment while supporting HR initiatives.
* **Confidentiality:** Strong sense of professionalism and discretion when handling sensitive employee information. Ability to maintain confidentiality in all aspects of the role.

title: HR Shared Service Analyst
description:
Job Summary:
  

The Shared Services Analyst I provides support for HR activities with a strong emphasis on learning and development, being the key contact for matters relating to process excellence and support. The specialist will provide day\-to\-day support for escalated HR inquiries and supports scheduled and ad hoc data requests from partners. Requires strong collaboration, attention to detail, and superior service delivery qualities.


Responsibilities:
  

30% Supports administration activities, such as Workday/LMS administration, records upkeep, ad hoc reporting, data auditing, and general recordkeeping, and recommends ways to improve and standardize work to support automation where feasible.


15% Resolves Tier 1 and Tier 2 inquiries and collaborates with COE stakeholders for quick and effective resolution.


15% Supports programs and campaign rollouts by participating in solution review, testing, and knowledge article creation. Assists in maintaining course catalogue, logistics, and enrollment.


10% Compiles reporting and trend analysis supporting internal practice and program KPIs to help inform COE of program success and trending issues.


10% Identifies opportunities for continuous improvement initiatives and proposes solutions and ideas to find more efficient ways to deliver HR support to candidates, employees, and people leaders.


5% Builds and maintains relationships with key stakeholder groups.


5% Supports vendor\-invoice processes in Ariba.


5% Performs other duties as assigned, such as special projects and initiatives related to the role. May choose to participate in non\-related initiatives as part of growth and learning objective. Understands the need for appropriate data privacy protections when working with employee data.


5% Performs other duties as assigned.


Additional Requirements:
  

* Bachelor’s degree, applicable certification or equivalent experience.
* Typically requires less than 2 years of professional experience where knowledge base is generally acquired from a college degree or equivalent course experience.
* 3\+ years HR experience, preferably in Learning and Development capacity
* Must have excellent writing and communication skills. Above average ability to read, write, and speak English. Multilingual a plus.
* Ability to manage multiple, often complex, tasks at the same time. Ability to stay focused on key timeline/deliverables. Strong project, time management, and organizational skills. Intermediate understanding of event and project management both domestically and internationally.
* Proactive, consistently anticipates stakeholder needs, self motivated, accountable, and goal oriented
* Advanced skills with Workday Learning Module
* Clear communication skills. Able to balance the need to seek information with the need to be understood. Able to communicate effectively in varied settings and cultures.
* Strong Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and Outlook skills
* Advanced skills in SAP's Ariba Procurement and Concur Expense and Travel systems
* Advanced skill in SharePoint, with ability to consult, design, build, and maintain content

* Travel: Occasional \- 10%
* Work Schedule: Standard Hours

Typical Office: Operates in a typical office environment, routinely uses computer and other standard office equipment.

Typical Office: Generally sedentary for prolonged periods, may occasionally require ability to move about or adjust/move items weighing up to 10 lbs. in all directions; Constantly requires collaboration and the ability to communicate with others to exchange information while in a typical office setting.
